Peter,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Hardworking New Mexicans are suffering from these failures. We need new leadership in Washington who will improve, energize, and restore hope to our state and our country.

[**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and I’m asking for your support to help me restore fiscally conservative, commonsense, and impactful leadership both in New Mexico and the U.S. Senate by making a Week One donation to my campaign today.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aa9eaa03a0af4558baee8524fedf0b7c&_e=RQOK8CnjyyALQINDyHziAMEVgvNL0X1yjiNNV8RquooqzF4Rjy4asIWAVAW4plL_yP4E78QVSf40Zthf8qaily2e2L5qzu74NWqIyrr_7DqUY5LdaELhVoIGDN-nIBQzx_BEvWzCd_X5iwWn5SolFdRy4TsxZuyzchxwcAR8Buv-Rn_YU5FMHF_VoJtUBpOCQi5NlZldCYlDMWwSeG0nwEO5NgmqQOzK-0hbczFKzl3gDvnuC7QFtdVUQNHV7RcMXgxPFZgK5bqkQ7YalQf71GDKDdhV68C1bSKJBgCrAewnkZ14LDjGwQuGEM8kU04P1CTwwu2Mo5Afg8H3OZg3HXSQKPWlhhQRADGNXJ9MPI27AHRBO2DjtAalEWWiHSJ5fSlKsl2SJ7SE0lokKkAjBA%3D%3D)

New Mexico is my home. **My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned.**

I understand the importance of hard work, like most New Mexicans. I waited tables to help pay for my undergraduate degree from Georgetown University. While holding down a full-time job, I paid my way through night school at Georgetown Law. I also paid for Harvard Business School, graduating as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while nine months pregnant.

I began my career at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I have advised, invested in, grown, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. **Collectively, the companies I have been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.**

I am uniquely prepared and qualified to fight for a significantly improved New Mexican economy. My professional experience and education enable me to deeply understand taxation, inflation, setting and managing huge budgets, and creating incentives and benefits that serve employees, and attract new businesses and entrepreneurs.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity, rich traditions, hard-working people, and leading national laboratories and military installations. **But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us.**

I will fight to secure our borders, bring costs down, ease financial burdens on New Mexico families struggling to get by, and ensure America is once again the land of opportunity and freedom.

**I’m in this fight to win – and with your support, we will get the job done to flip this seat and restore a Republican majority in the Senate!**

[**We can and must do better for New Mexico and America. Will you join me in this fight and help me officially kick off our campaign to win back this seat and the majority by contributing to my campaign with a Week One donation?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aa9eaa03a0af4558baee8524fedf0b7c&_e=RQOK8CnjyyALQINDyHziAMEVgvNL0X1yjiNNV8RquooqzF4Rjy4asIWAVAW4plL_yP4E78QVSf40Zthf8qaily2e2L5qzu74NWqIyrr_7DqUY5LdaELhVoIGDN-nIBQzx_BEvWzCd_X5iwWn5SolFdRy4TsxZuyzchxwcAR8Buv-Rn_YU5FMHF_VoJtUBpOCQi5NlZldCYlDMWwSeG0nwEO5NgmqQOzK-0hbczFKzl0UpvqVRTXPPvibnQw571Bg6fjXtlCxKEQilYJK9eIgJat6JDQE5HwLJ_b4VeapSU1elL51atQZb_PAB7guGbD9iq87Yj1QFp9EH7kiqajGKYpRf5M8NxaLlBgRY7WhQfhz7U3mitfq-FxrjCeJGbGA0wqfvOVIBKsni5Ekf4X8cw%3D%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**“New Mexico is my home. I was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of my childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas Blvd. and Monroe St. with my seven brothers, sisters, and parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. I began my education at Our Lady of Fatima, where I learned the values I hold today. I am the devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned, no matter where my life has taken me. My husband Pat and I cherish our home in New Mexico, that we have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like my father and mother, I have been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those whom quality healthcare was out of reach. I have also been a champion of improving the education of our youth in underserved communities.

In my career, I helped build businesses, helped companies grow, and created jobs. With this business experience, I will help New Mexico attract new companies and create jobs - so hardworking New Mexicans can find success and live their American Dream.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity and rich traditions, hardworking people, and leading national laboratories. The cost of living is up, we are in a crime crisis, the border is wide open, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.

We are clearly on the wrong track. We can and must do better. That’s why I am running for the United States Senate.” _-Nella_**

# SB 52 Update: Bill to Kill Blue Line Scheduled for Senate Floor Thursday
| |
* * *
---
## SB 52 Threatens Transit for All, Not Just Indy
---
It's just been announced that **the Senate will consider SB 52 this Thursday**. Make no mistake: this bill is part of a campaign against IndyGo's Blue Line, a project years in the making that would connect some of Indy's most underserved communities with the rest of our city. However, the language of the bill threatens future transit projects everywhere.
I'm writing an open letter to my Senate colleagues on both sides of the aisle to share what this project means to our city and urge them to protect transit statewide. **You can read and sign that letter[here on my website](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvczQ2LyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAxMjQuODkwMzA0ODEifQ.QxSVFbzI-Y5ngppS-JpwEXHd6mEVRf_6BJkrO18ZTik/s/2950175210/br/235865465972-l)**, and I'll share the text below:

Dr. Jane Goodall, a celebrated primatologist who spent decades studying chimpanzees, spoke recently at the World Economic Forum.

Friend, I couldn't agree more.

I would be honored to have your support in that effort. Your grassroots contributions are going a long way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]

We need a leader who will fight for an economy that works for working people. That means revitalizing manufacturing, $10 a day childcare, and building a new clean energy future. That’s NOT Trump. If we stand together, we can protect our economy, our democracy, and our future.

Ro

Fellow American,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Hardworking New Mexicans are suffering from these failures. We need new leadership in Washington who will improve, energize, and restore hope to our state and our country.

[**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and I’m asking for your support to help me restore fiscally conservative, commonsense, and impactful leadership both in New Mexico and the U.S. Senate by making a Week One donation to my campaign today.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c2eac0bfa9784a79a21eefd3da67c21b&_e=jZYzuuaEjAfnDKW1WdW-tal1oovAEgLP8RTBw0bpRFqE3ayModjlHa79PKq--T0H8S_l3Ekjm3CcSkrZayR0OhGndGsnWBBrmNgg9tdoWx5v9sKYs6Uh6zjvsfzE6B9hltNPukawt1LF1jsDJ-rEQusPOe-t-Y6skCdQCV1A-v_1OiDPi10kQfTAuhf5in811yG3NIkorXqQejKWYEYw9TSKBddJbzorZ-2v7seCowNGmNW-XBVmc9D_qalIG_k_E1ECLuXziIurrn7bj17ArLFNqRlL7uyydfBKSkcT_dovMh5VOPBrmhbjayNHmCScfFeXFW4YE9aq7YujmcnFxFPWBV9fl7-YX-lFsULlD-N4fO-Qn_efEkTt1r2sUKyF4LFDMmsszrPuGTM68EYvlg%3D%3D)

[ ** JOIN THE FIGHT WITH NELLA » **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c2eac0bfa9784a79a21eefd3da67c21b&_e=jZYzuuaEjAfnDKW1WdW-tal1oovAEgLP8RTBw0bpRFqE3ayModjlHa79PKq--T0H8S_l3Ekjm3CcSkrZayR0OhGndGsnWBBrmNgg9tdoWx5v9sKYs6Uh6zjvsfzE6B9hltNPukawt1LF1jsDJ-rEQusPOe-t-Y6skCdQCV1A-v_1OiDPi10kQfTAuhf5in811yG3NIkorXqQejKWYEYw9TSKBddJbzorZ-2v7seCowNGmNW-XBVmc9D_qalIG_k_Bdo3FNtxXSOT_A4D3xNOsK-8qBp6i2s_-c_Vmq6f7hziK6wxmo0sQhGn2IUmwkyVG26xCPOr3cAsUG3iF4DUjavuOemi6OE5Twh7lo9-1Zp0-LzfSEo_K_CwKw3aGnRwDR4SQBE-7HprCQcXNCNrug%3D%3D)
New Mexico is my home. **My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned.**

I understand the importance of hard work, like most New Mexicans. I waited tables to help pay for my undergraduate degree from Georgetown University. While holding down a full-time job, I paid my way through night school at Georgetown Law. I also paid for Harvard Business School, graduating as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while nine months pregnant.

I began my career at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I have advised, invested in, grown, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. **Collectively, the companies I have been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.**

I am uniquely prepared and qualified to fight for a significantly improved New Mexican economy. My professional experience and education enable me to deeply understand taxation, inflation, setting and managing huge budgets, and creating incentives and benefits that serve employees, and attract new businesses and entrepreneurs.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity, rich traditions, hard-working people, and leading national laboratories and military installations. **But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us.**

I will fight to secure our borders, bring costs down, ease financial burdens on New Mexico families struggling to get by, and ensure America is once again the land of opportunity and freedom.

**I’m in this fight to win – and with your support, we will get the job done to flip this seat and restore a Republican majority in the Senate!**

[**We can and must do better for New Mexico and America. Will you join me in this fight and help me officially kick off our campaign to win back this seat and the majority by contributing to my campaign with a Week One donation?**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c2eac0bfa9784a79a21eefd3da67c21b&_e=jZYzuuaEjAfnDKW1WdW-tal1oovAEgLP8RTBw0bpRFqE3ayModjlHa79PKq--T0H8S_l3Ekjm3CcSkrZayR0OhGndGsnWBBrmNgg9tdoWx5v9sKYs6Uh6zjvsfzE6B9hltNPukawt1LF1jsDJ-rEQusPOe-t-Y6skCdQCV1A-v_1OiDPi10kQfTAuhf5in811yG3NIkorXqQejKWYEYw9TSKBddJbzorZ-2v7seCowNGmNW-XBVmc9D_qalIG_k_tcFqOOVVIkgPsSC0HRAvfI2I1R-Gl1ixUkUzKRFsLSdKBXjwnRkCyi_y6PlSjbtn9n-YkuEGAqvEZnRbTU9C5e4YpNBNZxINjSmyY5FWh2jz8FAltrl7LOZu8SaI4qX3UlZRUBaSw4abW5lVUPBg8Q%3D%3D)

[ ** JOIN THE FIGHT WITH NELLA » **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c2eac0bfa9784a79a21eefd3da67c21b&_e=jZYzuuaEjAfnDKW1WdW-tal1oovAEgLP8RTBw0bpRFqE3ayModjlHa79PKq--T0H8S_l3Ekjm3CcSkrZayR0OhGndGsnWBBrmNgg9tdoWx5v9sKYs6Uh6zjvsfzE6B9hltNPukawt1LF1jsDJ-rEQusPOe-t-Y6skCdQCV1A-v_1OiDPi10kQfTAuhf5in811yG3NIkorXqQejKWYEYw9TSKBddJbzorZ-2v7seCowNGmNW-XBVmc9D_qalIG_k_AB0dRvcTVMPZr9baQ4NOB2HJwQ5aIf_zUJ2vt2KxMsCJG8nUu4IL3nUpSTnkTfTUgWRSAfGCog8lDA7emdalAxyByeBo32FZkQbkcSE2nmhnip_uGTUqzhFPoGWMo5yziFC6xwvGDX632IvdhkpzUQ%3D%3D)
With you in the fight,

_**Nella Domenici**_
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**“New Mexico is my home. I was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of my childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas Blvd. and Monroe St. with my seven brothers, sisters, and parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. I began my education at Our Lady of Fatima, where I learned the values I hold today. I am the devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned, no matter where my life has taken me. My husband Pat and I cherish our home in New Mexico, that we have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like my father and mother, I have been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those whom quality healthcare was out of reach. I have also been a champion of improving the education of our youth in underserved communities.

Like everyone starting their career, I began at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I helped build businesses, helped companies grow, and created jobs. With this business experience, I will help New Mexico attract new companies and create jobs - so hardworking New Mexicans can find success and live their American Dream.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity and rich traditions, hardworking people, and leading national laboratories. But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us. The cost of living is up, we are in a crime crisis, the border is wide open, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.

We are clearly on the wrong track. We can and must do better. That’s why I am running for the United States Senate.” _-Nella_**

Hello, With almost 3,000 farms and some of the most fertile soil in the country, it’s no surprise that agriculture is the number one economic driver in communities throughout Central and Southern Illinois. That’s why I was proud to join colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote for an extension of the Farm Bill last year. While I am happy that we were able to sustain vital nutrition programs like SNAP, we owe it to farmers across the country to put aside partisan games and finally pass a bipartisan Farm Bill that prioritizes our communities. In case you need a refresher, every five years the Agriculture Committee drafts legislation for the Farm Bill, but thanks to House Republicans' failed leadership, we haven’t been able to get it done. Working on both sides of the aisle to make progress for working families, farmers, and veterans is one of my top priorities in Congress, so I will continue to advocate for swift passage of a bipartisan Farm Bill that includes funding for vital programs like SNAP and the _Inflation Reduction Act_ subsidy programs. But the road ahead won’t be easy. I am up for reelection this year and have **two Republican opponents** vying to take this seat and impede our progress. clean_body: | Hello, With almost 3,000 farms and some of the most fertile soil in the country, it’s no surprise that agriculture is the number one economic driver in communities throughout Central and Southern Illinois. That’s why I was proud to join colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote for an extension of the Farm Bill last year. While I am happy that we were able to sustain vital nutrition programs like SNAP, we owe it to farmers across the country to put aside partisan games and finally pass a bipartisan Farm Bill that prioritizes our communities. In case you need a refresher, every five years the Agriculture Committee drafts legislation for the Farm Bill, but thanks to House Republicans' failed leadership, we haven’t been able to get it done. Working on both sides of the aisle to make progress for working families, farmers, and veterans is one of my top priorities in Congress, so I will continue to advocate for swift passage of a bipartisan Farm Bill that includes funding for vital programs like SNAP and the Inflation Reduction Act subsidy programs. But the road ahead won’t be easy. I am up for reelection this year and have two Republican opponents vying to take this seat and impede our progress. That’s why it’s more important than ever that we work together to protect this seat, keep this district blue, and ensure we can pass a bipartisan Farm Bill that will expand job opportunities, put food on the table for families, and provide our farmers with the resources they deserve. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | | = ** = | = = | = = Thanks for standing with me. — Nikki = Nikki for Congress PO Box 5171 Springfield, IL 62705 United States | mailto:info@nikkiforcongress.com | Paid for by Nikki Budzinski for Congress

Suzanne Crouch releases statement endorsing President Trump after New Hampshire primary

Indianapolis, IND — Republican gubernatorial candidate and Indiana's 52nd Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch released the following statement after President Donald Trump's resounding victory in the New Hampshire primary:

“President Donald Trump’s victory in New Hampshire this evening is a testament to his popularity and resilience. We need a president who grows the economy—not our list of enemies. We need a return to economic growth, a strong foreign policy, and a chief executive who cares about our borders. All Republicans need to unite behind the next president of the United States—Donald Trump."

With a race in the margin of error and enough undecided voters left to sway the election either way, we need to redouble our efforts to win! With just 21 days until Election Day, we need all hands on deck to make sure we have the resources to keep our ads on TV, send out mailers, and sustain our voter contact operation all the way to the finish line. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. | = | = | = | = | = I know you know how much is at stake in this race. An affordability crisis, climate change, gun violence, the immigration crisis–we need solutions for all of these problems, and we need common-sense leaders who can come together to solve them. But this poll shows how much work we have to do in just 21 days to get that done! Every dollar you give will directly help our critical voter outreach efforts. Please chip in now. | = Thank you, Tom Suozzi * | | = Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee. Friend,
Recently, I introduced the******Protect Medicaid Act,** a bill designed to prevent federal tax dollars from funding Medicaid for illegal immigrants.
This critical piece of legislation is a direct response to liberal states like California, which have chosen to prioritize illegal immigrants over the American people.
_**Friend**_**, I cannot sit by while middle-class Americans are forced to subsidize the healthcare of individuals who chose to illegally enter our country.**
Our compassion means NOTHING if we don’t even have the resources to care for our most vulnerable Americans.

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

This critical piece of legislation is a direct response to liberal states like California, which have chosen to prioritize illegal immigrants over the American people. Friend, I cannot sit by while middle-class Americans are forced to subsidize the healthcare of individuals who chose to illegally enter our country. | Peter, did you read Ami’s note about the anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_?

It’s so important that we protect a woman’s right to choose against far-right extremists who, in a post-Roe America, are trying to dismantle these essential rights.

**_[Add your name to our petition before midnight tonight to help protect our freedoms.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77618256/451005212/1138127263?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240123_PT_1.2_1MO_hq_NA_NA_roevwade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFhNGNiYi01ZmJhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ixkV1AgDm2L5hG3VoA19FvD_9W6yqBZ0-xr3XZFVwM=&emci=591a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&emdi=5b1a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&ceid=32394541)_**

Thanks so much!

Team Bera
* * *

Peter,

Today marks the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_. But instead of celebrating, because of the Supreme Court dismantling all those years of precedent with their Dobbs decision a year and a half ago, instead today serves as a reminder that we need to fight to protect reproductive health care rights from extremist fringes.

Just this month, MAGA republicans in the House introduced new anti-choice legislation—they’ve made it clear that if they win big in November they would push for a national abortion ban.

We’re also seeing the Supreme Court prepare to hear arguments in a case that could undo the FDA’s decades old approval of the leading abortion medication—a terrible precedent not just on this issue, but for the whole medical community.

This all falls under the backdrop of more states pushing unpopular anti-choice bans through.

Extremist Republicans are working hard to strip women of their right to choose and I’m not going to stand for it.

**_[Will you help me defend the right to choose from the interference of the far-right? Sign our petition HERE →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77618257/451005213/1138127263?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240123_PT_1.2_1MO_hq_NA_NA_roevwade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFhNGNiYi01ZmJhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ixkV1AgDm2L5hG3VoA19FvD_9W6yqBZ0-xr3XZFVwM=&emci=591a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&emdi=5b1a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&ceid=32394541)_** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77618258/451005214/1138127263?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240123_PT_1.2_1MO_hq_NA_NA_roevwade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFhNGNiYi01ZmJhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ixkV1AgDm2L5hG3VoA19FvD_9W6yqBZ0-xr3XZFVwM=&emci=591a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&emdi=5b1a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&ceid=32394541) **[ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77618259/451005215/1138127263?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240123_PT_1.2_1MO_hq_NA_NA_roevwade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFhNGNiYi01ZmJhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ixkV1AgDm2L5hG3VoA19FvD_9W6yqBZ0-xr3XZFVwM=&emci=591a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&emdi=5b1a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&ceid=32394541)**
In Congress, I’ve supported measures to codify reproductive rights into federal law. I’ve also introduced legislation to ensure insurance companies fully cover over-the-counter birth control without any out-of-pocket costs.

This issue should be between patients and doctors, not politicians and judges.

**_[Now is the time to make our voices heard: Click here to add your name to our petition to support reproductive health care!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77618260/451005216/1138127263?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240123_PT_1.2_1MO_hq_NA_NA_roevwade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFhNGNiYi01ZmJhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ixkV1AgDm2L5hG3VoA19FvD_9W6yqBZ0-xr3XZFVwM=&emci=591a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&emdi=5b1a4cbb-5fba-ee11-bea1-002248223848&ceid=32394541)_**

Be well,
Ami

By Illinois Review

President Donald Trump cruised to victory in Tuesday night’s New Hampshire Primary, easily beating his Republican opponent Nikki Haley and solidifying his status as the presumptive Republican nominee for President of the United States.

An hour after the polls closed, news outlets were already declaring that Trump was the projected winner – and Haley wasted no time taking the stage and delivering what appeared to be a victory speech.

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7hb4o33hgka3qmoh8bgaj64ni9a1qcn69v66mt8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1iecp34clh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsf4d2ttfcaqm90bgjgvssp0jccemnpkuok8ivh0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1iecp34clh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj3p48ktmd6pu69bjjmcmgte1kvmcgc5f1157i80_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1iecp34clh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history. Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights Hides the corruption of the ruling class Attacks those with traditional viewpoints That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: The Declaration of Independence argues that the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights and that just government is founded on the consent of the governed. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: The Divine Comedy
body:
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgrc333k810mfg885huiibicqrqlgd8ngph9s6go_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow citizen,
Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places.
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems, _The Divine Comedy_. Taking an imaginary journey through the three realms of the afterlife—Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise—he encounters old enemies and cherished friends, crooked politicians and great statesmen, infamous sinners, and holy saints.
The result is a profound education in character, as the poet learns how to order his soul to lead a free and happy life. And _The Divine Comedy_ is a delight to read.
**This is why Hillsdale College has produced an online course, “Dante’s _Divine Comedy,_ ” about this monumental work of literature. **
---
| | And now, the course about this timeless masterpiece is available on DVD for your home library, Bible study, or book club.
You can receive the DVD of **“Dante’s _Divine Comedy_ ” **in a handsome box set for a gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale and its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, like free online courses.
We**** produce our free online courses, as we do all of our work, without accepting ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zouv5o42k6n1d82rcgb5c8c1cjp42db46eh1gkg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)
---
| | With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of Americans in online courses, as well as reach and teach increasing millions for liberty. Please support Hillsdale’s educational outreach on behalf of liberty and receive your DVD of **“Dante’s _Divine Comedy_ ” **by giving your best tax-deductible gift of $100 or more today using this secure link:
**_[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-dante-divine-comedy-course](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm5v481ntfdj9l9rudvs2dm36hu3dm9lnftkt3jo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)_**
We are deeply grateful for your friendship and support.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z40ovhtdoqnb4eoh8g55h7skn11bgbgsj0aqs47g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp8u94upt6dipffakqvsgfvsftkonhbb19b4fh0o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpdiqrfuokjnr6horfkgc80iatggbk3mevbg7h5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoo95ujg0vpv139rd7r65i4r7bhkssqtt9tla2f0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0qtcagimkci49g7pq1q6nae22evtnc16kjlpu7g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31chh2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: This is the most tragic lie in America today
body:
Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls

| [ ](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4pj70e3pfrl6a9l58l2llm596lk2sm8917dlreg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31cjh2bs)
---
Fellow American,

Care, no matter what.

This is the motto of Planned Parenthood. While it sounds great on the surface, Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls, and to the American people through manipulative and dangerously subtle language.

While they claim to provide healthcare services to women no matter who they are or where they live, abortion can never be healthcare. Further, while they claim to provide numerous services to women, 97.2% of Planned Parenthood's pregnancy resolution services are devoted to abortions, the purposeful ending of an unborn baby's life.

**[Does 97.2% of cases brought to Planned Parenthood that end in the death of an innocent child sound like"care" to you?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmf5p8dpilp212jo2aarto0o366cbhstca4fg0p8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31cjh2bs)**

Planned Parenthood cares only about the business. It preys on the vulnerable, thrives on women's fear, and fuels itself on greed. When a woman arrives seeking answers to an unexpected pregnancy, the clock to gain a profit starts ticking. They will do whatever they can to make a woman agree to an abortion because each abortion completed is more profit in their pockets.

At SBA Pro-Life America, we are committed to stopping the manipulation and the gruesome deaths of innocent babies. In the last 10 years, Planned Parenthood has the lifeblood of 3.4 million babies on their hands.

[We cannot be the only voice fighting for these precious children and exposing the lies of Planned Parenthood.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbsmitelcqvl0l19le14c8tokgro6v9och1l2qv0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31cjh2bs) Would you stand with us and commit to protecting women and unborn babies from the dangers of Planned Parenthood? By signing our pledge to stop Planned Parenthood, you are helping SBA Pro-Life America fight this "_David vs Goliath_ " battle.

Whether you know it or not, Planned Parenthood is impacting YOUR community and YOUR family by taking your hard-earned tax dollars to fund abortions and devaluing the unborn in our country.

**The lies, manipulation, and millions of deaths must come to an end now.**

Help us fight for the vulnerable by standing up against Planned Parenthood by signing our pledge at the link below:

[SIGN YOUR NAME](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbkn7ihf6225udj45tv08f45sd235h5ju79vvfr0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ie2o31cjh2bs)
| I can't tell you how important your commitment is today to the pro-life movement and the generations to come tomorrow.

| _Who are you partnered with?_ It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the right fit for you.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681307%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L87MDEp4ekFw%2bvxL7CpxEw&sysid=1)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, it can seem daunting to choose one. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681308%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wvaalwsm5qg32g06fMnPmg&sysid=1) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to work towards a comfortable retirement.

| Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you, like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives according to their faith. That's why I created the American Cornerstone Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we can't do it alone.

**We need your voice.**

I want to personally invite you to participate in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**You can share your thoughts using this secure link:[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._0I2kGpxfSaA)**

[Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete the survey.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-UCA) Your input is vital in helping us understand the scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of our American society.

Dr. Ben Carson

name: Your America
subject: The Divine Comedy
body:
This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38406%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1hg5e5iy1QDOrs7hH%2fvMOA&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow citizen, Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places. While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems, _The Divine Comedy_. Taking an imaginary journey through the three realms of the afterlife--Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise--he encounters old enemies and cherished friends, crooked politicians and great statesmen, infamous sinners, and holy saints. The result is a profound education in character, as the poet learns how to order his soul to lead a free and happy life. And _The Divine Comedy_ is a delight to read. **This is why Hillsdale College has produced an online course, “Dante’s _Divine Comedy,_ ” about this monumental work of literature. **
---
| | And now, the course about this timeless masterpiece is available on DVD for your home library, Bible study, or book club. You can receive the DVD of **“Dante’s _Divine Comedy_ ” **in a handsome box set for a gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale and its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, like free online courses. We** ** produce our free online courses, as we do all of our work, without accepting ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
---

---

Please support Hillsdale’s educational outreach on behalf of liberty and receive your DVD of **“Dante’s _Divine Comedy_ ” **by giving your best tax-deductible gift of $100 or more today using this secure link: **_[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-dante-divine-comedy-course](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38408%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=83uYTT9Puor8E4Tu7fNAng&sysid=1)_** We are deeply grateful for your friendship and support. name: American Action News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq3t0auqbuhg5p1650tram081tsh741e2lh2laa8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ieeor0clh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znhq1du3d3u2ofeof2le241br0lp2g2o0i1q3m5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ieeor0clh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvikp6b6ft5uu67tp1g3vkr6jpi9ce600155gtu0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c1ieeor0clh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places.
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems, _The Divine Comedy_. Taking an imaginary journey through the three realms of the afterlife—Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise—he encounters old enemies and cherished friends, crooked politicians and great statesmen, infamous sinners, and holy saints.
The result is a profound education in character, as the poet learns how to order his soul to lead a free and happy life. And _The Divine Comedy_ is a delight to read.
**This is why Hillsdale College has produced an online course, “Dante’s _Divine Comedy,_ ” about this monumental work of literature. **

Fellow American: A Massachusetts school has censored a seventh grader for wearing a shirt that expresses biological truth. Throughout the entire nation, a debate is raging on the very nature of what it means to be human. What makes a person a man? A woman? Our Constitution guarantees freedom of thought—the freedom to share your beliefs. **Twelve-year-old Liam Morrison’s school has decided that debate is out—and government orthodoxy is in.** Liam, a 12-year-old student at Nichols Middle School in Middleborough, Massachusetts, quietly observed how the school proclaimed loudly that a person’s feelings, not their biology, determines their sex and gender. Liam holds different beliefs. Informed by a scientific understanding of biology (and backed by millennia of human history), he believes that there only two sexes (male and female) and that a person’s gender is inseparable from their sex. **So, one day Liam wore a shirt to school that says, “There are only two genders.”** The principal of the school, along with a school counselor, pulled Liam out of class and ordered him to remove his shirt or go home. Liam politely declined and was sent home. **Public school officials cannot censor a 7th grader’s speech by forcing him to remove a shirt that states scientific fact. This is a gross violation of the First Amendment.** **[Please stand with this brave 7th grader as he challenges his school’s violation of free speech. Sign our pledge to show that Liam isn’t the only one who is standing up for these truths.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDI0LWE5YTNhY2VkMzg2ZjQyZWE4MmIyMTVkMDMwZmVmMzI5IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvaHV0dXFsaGZ1Zj9zcmM9RkZPNDU4MjcifQ/RAQ70xTZssyhxy35oUOG3w)**

---
**“They completely took away my ability to have a different opinion than they wanted me to have,” Liam says.** This case isn’t just about a shirt.
* **It’s about a public school telling Liam** —and thereby all other students—that he can’t wear a shirt with a message that’s important to him unless it’s the same opinion as the government’s.
* **It’s about a public school trying to force a student** to forfeit his free speech when he walks into the school building.
* **It’s about a public school imposing its view on students** —and censoring students who disagree.

“The school is talking about this issue all the time,” ADF Senior Counsel Tyson Langhofer, who is defending Liam, says, “and all Liam wanted to do was express his opinion, which is actually shared by a lot of his classmates.” After the school punished Liam for wearing the shirt, he wore another shirt to protest the school’s censorship that said: “There are censored genders.” Again, the school told him to take off the shirt. That’s when Liam and his family decided to ask Alliance Defending Freedom and the Massachusetts Family Institute to take legal action.
---
[**Sign the Pledge**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDI0LWE5YTNhY2VkMzg2ZjQyZWE4MmIyMTVkMDMwZmVmMzI5IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvaHV0dXFsaGZ1Zj9zcmM9RkZPNDU4MjcifQ/nDbdcTBPmk5jF-aL2qkfbA)
---
“I don’t complain when I see pride flags and diversity posters hung throughout the school,” Liam told a meeting of the Middleboro School Committee in April, after he was punished the first time. “Others have a right to their beliefs just like I do.” **The First Amendment protects people of all beliefs, especially people that disagree with the government. If you only have freedom to agree with those in power, you don’t have freedom at all.** Across the nation, government officials are trying to silence views that differ from radical gender ideology. And it’s falling to brave 12-year-olds like Liam to stand in opposition and not affirm lies when school officials, who should be modeling adulthood, have failed students. **[Will you join Liam today?](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDI0LWE5YTNhY2VkMzg2ZjQyZWE4MmIyMTVkMDMwZmVmMzI5IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjQiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvaHV0dXFsaGZ1Zj9zcmM9RkZPNDU4MjcifQ/7oBVFluh_BcBWZxE9oCElg)**

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9ce6llhed4se81rhqbmshir6q33sk7ikmhsk8mg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chg62o72chh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfu9jdr3esq5kvb65s0oemu1pnrndkkrm2nqg310_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chg62o72chh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg1r91af3793tv1rcgh5p4emtuak36u5qkop98ig_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chg62o72chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

body:
This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3cabe86e334043eebc2a4303e162fea3&_e=gHu6-vS_l4PYIAfKcjJkDZvDkYDaNzz6onxdTDtvqeuKRUoA9G3bx9bf6TLCfLGTN8f7NMsXFdUJV7i2ZGiiwZQ0ebQ_PZuPXwRANYN_J0B2yviAYHHHEbH1aAoZVZATSaubSxfl6iCvqtDF5WSn4BOJUH00okmS6AkV4ExQ8ygqtVACSeFMAtPaWMcXC1NrEGilac-uDgN4Gb6khHf1NKLRRgwQXt9G1bDRxTMPx8pk9E8yOD6XgkGsmqBEi1v_bAvrJfzbGxbTp9zkgo7RyJiZtPQBlvEA1enRW39K4igQK3TD-6DKCGWR4dTinyy4k-XZerPmqI9Ysuf3vVAxLKv-Z01O9G3tP3MooQ8qM46rNwKMthay64GbmTD0yz1a_96skkF-UFkiKo8RsWov0ClNF73MtUDJTOHJpUHqmXQ%3D)
---
| | Dear fellow citizen,
Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places.

name: The Capitol Report
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from The Capitol Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://email.alert.thecapitolreport.news/c/eJyMkbuO2zAQRb-G6iQMH0tbhQojWlfZTZAESEnQnJFNgy-QVBb5-8CI06edizmDM_fnm3mzPvh0fbeRlu6qqc2UmptJ1mC-j22vv-i3ESDUCHwUyrwMuHB3lJseaOEH0DDPXMJwWy6KLi9wPOrD7MBaPOImNXLFSSEKmge_PDjAheKgtBQTapSXeYMZOHKxCabABqp96jdytvieQ6WSa58SfbQhLLfeS2PyxMSZiXMo082H0NAGmgh3Js5IxdYeKfUxb-N9b907elo8luS5OSZX4KDgHYQSn-G0fllfX78zofceTct7dcTk-vhCIdd9uj6jSOj3yORK0frwHDobi_XXxOSK-f7v0N8op06pM7l-PY0_Pn0bn_ZiqAuWDx-Cb_rAFFwfvMnlOPT_7OBPAAAA__8EXI7c) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.alert.thecapitolreport.news/c/eJyMkbuO2zAQRb-G6iQMH0tbhQojWlfZTZAESEnQnJFNgy-QVBb5-8CI06edizmDM_fnm3mzPvh0fbeRlu6qqc2UmptJ1mC-j22vv-i3ESDUCHwUyrwMuHB3lJseaOEH0DDPXMJwWy6KLi9wPOrD7MBaPOImNXLFSSEKmge_PDjAheKgtBQTapSXeYMZOHKxCabABqp96jdytvieQ6WSa58SfbQhLLfeS2PyxMSZiXMo082H0NAGmgh3Js5IxdYeKfUxb-N9b907elo8luS5OSZX4KDgHYQSn-G0fllfX78zofceTct7dcTk-vhCIdd9uj6jSOj3yORK0frwHDobi_XXxOSK-f7v0N8op06pM7l-PY0_Pn0bn_ZiqAuWDx-Cb_rAFFwfvMnlOPT_7OBPAAAA__8EXI7c)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.alert.thecapitolreport.news/c/eJyMkbuO2zAQRb-G6iQMH0tbhQojWlfZTZAESEnQnJFNgy-QVBb5-8CI06edizmDM_fnm3mzPvh0fbeRlu6qqc2UmptJ1mC-j22vv-i3ESDUCHwUyrwMuHB3lJseaOEH0DDPXMJwWy6KLi9wPOrD7MBaPOImNXLFSSEKmge_PDjAheKgtBQTapSXeYMZOHKxCabABqp96jdytvieQ6WSa58SfbQhLLfeS2PyxMSZiXMo082H0NAGmgh3Js5IxdYeKfUxb-N9b907elo8luS5OSZX4KDgHYQSn-G0fllfX78zofceTct7dcTk-vhCIdd9uj6jSOj3yORK0frwHDobi_XXxOSK-f7v0N8op06pM7l-PY0_Pn0bn_ZiqAuWDx-Cb_rAFFwfvMnlOPT_7OBPAAAA__8EXI7c)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| The Capitol Report

body:

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
