| | Dear fellow citizen,
Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places.
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems, _The Divine Comedy_. Taking an imaginary journey through the three realms of the afterlife—Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise—he encounters old enemies and cherished friends, crooked politicians and great statesmen, infamous sinners, and holy saints.
The result is a profound education in character, as the poet learns how to order his soul to lead a free and happy life. And _The Divine Comedy_ is a delight to read.
**This is why Hillsdale College has produced an online course, “Dante’s _Divine Comedy,_ ” about this monumental work of literature. **

| _Who are you partnered with?_ It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the right fit for you.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMG3xSeEvgATicV99NCcYg~~/AARclAA~-LBlA2s_glIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, it can seem daunting to choose one. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9yw6JaZnZgKvY3kT_SmdYA~~/AARclAA~-CUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to work towards a comfortable retirement.

subject: This is the most tragic lie in America today
body:
Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls

| [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6974bd90bf0489aa6c9c74dbd6150b3&_e=vhVMzgc8snFUD8sF5PaZdyHXyuJ6xtOwQDURgbFSNqXtWV8W41u2-i-_mlMEFTY_eHfr8nCde6r67gPh6oUsnehdrw6S1RCoaUE674IisyfTsM3mwlfVEQi0phkA5WHjCk6UXZG93ZYRXFOQwNiaguhLTYewGOIT0BMo0K9xkMY4FIrV8o2fKcoaS_T0O0g_ybZTJkAjmcYjgg4pvsDBOHVzfaoLPOUX969TWAnDZyJpELD_m6l93bDMtgLcIDhoSOE3O-vJFMD9mvqgpb3UmeSeotU7074jBm8NUwd3MTX0dkT9HebBBBwD93GGiSMe6Nkqi5lup6azIVHnBq_fie7xY3nS_CCd2x8ylR9OcnxG6gju5LeAFiW0mpUbQM75exGPwzPTY7pj2lZc08xGYIKg0fsvK-tyWITKNKLdm18%3D)
---
Fellow American,

Care, no matter what.

This is the motto of Planned Parenthood. While it sounds great on the surface, Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls, and to the American people through manipulative and dangerously subtle language.

While they claim to provide healthcare services to women no matter who they are or where they live, abortion can never be healthcare. Further, while they claim to provide numerous services to women, 97.2% of Planned Parenthood's pregnancy resolution services are devoted to abortions, the purposeful ending of an unborn baby's life.

**[Does 97.2% of cases brought to Planned Parenthood that end in the death of an innocent child sound like"care" to you?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6974bd90bf0489aa6c9c74dbd6150b3&_e=vhVMzgc8snFUD8sF5PaZdyHXyuJ6xtOwQDURgbFSNqXtWV8W41u2-i-_mlMEFTY_eHfr8nCde6r67gPh6oUsnehdrw6S1RCoaUE674IisyfTsM3mwlfVEQi0phkA5WHjCk6UXZG93ZYRXFOQwNiaguhLTYewGOIT0BMo0K9xkMY4FIrV8o2fKcoaS_T0O0g_ybZTJkAjmcYjgg4pvsDBOHVzfaoLPOUX969TWAnDZyJpELD_m6l93bDMtgLcIDhoSOE3O-vJFMD9mvqgpb3UmR5gB2nMhf1xU7csPZwP8ecMpHgJXnvt3xmMf_hdqE8mIvSIo4YwoQSG9D23MBZ8ik5gUKIvAHnzpWwBXy1Z7ATrC0ei1HSbWYhzuxGJlV6dE9cZ79yDfM-3clNKiTqR_7wF-m8DIhY0D5gWikE-Hzk%3D)**

Planned Parenthood cares only about the business. It preys on the vulnerable, thrives on women's fear, and fuels itself on greed. When a woman arrives seeking answers to an unexpected pregnancy, the clock to gain a profit starts ticking. They will do whatever they can to make a woman agree to an abortion because each abortion completed is more profit in their pockets.

At SBA Pro-Life America, we are committed to stopping the manipulation and the gruesome deaths of innocent babies. In the last 10 years, Planned Parenthood has the lifeblood of 3.4 million babies on their hands.

[We cannot be the only voice fighting for these precious children and exposing the lies of Planned Parenthood.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6974bd90bf0489aa6c9c74dbd6150b3&_e=vhVMzgc8snFUD8sF5PaZdyHXyuJ6xtOwQDURgbFSNqXtWV8W41u2-i-_mlMEFTY_eHfr8nCde6r67gPh6oUsnehdrw6S1RCoaUE674IisyfTsM3mwlfVEQi0phkA5WHjCk6UXZG93ZYRXFOQwNiaguhLTYewGOIT0BMo0K9xkMY4FIrV8o2fKcoaS_T0O0g_ybZTJkAjmcYjgg4pvsDBOHVzfaoLPOUX969TWAnDZyJpELD_m6l93bDMtgLcIDhoSOE3O-vJFMD9mvqgpb3UmQ60QRVfXJ7wAtyGo3slvi4lyiWtKfGDN0fddGH7n4zOiVTYYFXLfDtvOEuhJ_JHhpe_sEZ8dcqMTte4JdrZrPc_NOyyKo_8MLmqAuEWhX3vQwU7ItQh15IvXawy-oIs0bM0rjg59oe75rGKKlxsZeg%3D) Would you stand with us and commit to protecting women and unborn babies from the dangers of Planned Parenthood? By signing our pledge to stop Planned Parenthood, you are helping SBA Pro-Life America fight this "_David vs Goliath_ " battle.

Whether you know it or not, Planned Parenthood is impacting YOUR community and YOUR family by taking your hard-earned tax dollars to fund abortions and devaluing the unborn in our country.

**The lies, manipulation, and millions of deaths must come to an end now.**

Help us fight for the vulnerable by standing up against Planned Parenthood by signing our pledge at the link below:

[SIGN YOUR NAME](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6974bd90bf0489aa6c9c74dbd6150b3&_e=vhVMzgc8snFUD8sF5PaZdyHXyuJ6xtOwQDURgbFSNqXtWV8W41u2-i-_mlMEFTY_eHfr8nCde6r67gPh6oUsnehdrw6S1RCoaUE674IisyfTsM3mwlfVEQi0phkA5WHjCk6UXZG93ZYRXFOQwNiaguhLTYewGOIT0BMo0K9xkMY4FIrV8o2fKcoaS_T0O0g_ybZTJkAjmcYjgg4pvsDBOHVzfaoLPOUX969TWAnDZyJpELD_m6l93bDMtgLcIDhoSOE3O-vJFMD9mvqgpb3UmeoBwi-5sdkYc5ufrgmKE6loMDUir4tLmq5XuqAGK4F8vfQVgnsN6LBBlPB0-PJFUTNaHcwSjuZasmvaWnz9u2Bbt3vcngpFAe-AeVr-RCGpZj-wWpkmI1pctefQjC-Z-aD-NEJdGWSJOLR6KJhEjC4%3D)

name: Karen Dabney
subject: Defend Law Enforcement from George Soros
body:
He faces decades in prison for doing his job by the book.

Friend,

I've never done something like this before.

But right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own. And there's nothing I won't do to protect my family - even ask a perfect stranger for help.

Next month, my beloved son - former Deputy James Johnson of the Williamson County, TX Sheriff's Department - will go on trial for manslaughter.

He faces decades in prison for doing his job by the book.

This is a photo of James with his son.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkrr2hv0356r1684sb71ve2pq9671kcatav34abg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi6eob2cth2bs)
James dreamed of being a police officer ever since he took his first "ride-along" in a cop car at the age of 18.

How could we know back then that one day he would find himself the target of a nationwide political movement directed and financed by radical anti-cop billionaire George Soros?

**[If you're sick of our men and women in blue being targeted by anti-cop prosecutors, then I pray you'll find it in your heart to help my son today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8fom8clck695rlh233d7dqlnv16thgnorsrs640_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi6eob2cth2bs)**

Please let me explain...

On the night of March 28, 2019, my son conducted a routine traffic stop.

But instead of pulling over, the driver - a convicted drug dealer named Javier Ambler - floored the gas and tried to flee.

The suspect's speed quickly exceeded 100 miles per hour. Along the way, he collided with signs, trees, fences, and other roadside objects.

The chase lasted for 22 minutes and spanned two counties. At any moment, another driver or a pedestrian could have been struck and killed by the drug dealer's reckless driving. It was a deadly serious situation.

Eventually, the chase ended when the suspect crashed head-first into a tree.

My son ordered him to get on the ground at gunpoint. He refused. James ordered again, and still the driver did not comply.

That's when another Deputy and an Austin Police Officer arrived on scene. Together, they tried to handcuff the giant man - but he kept resisting and fighting to get back on his feet.

Now, my son is strong. . . but this man was twice his size. . . **nearly 400 pounds.** And even together, the three officers could not subdue him.

So, to put a stop to his fighting and get him handcuffed, they deployed a taser again.

Still nothing - he kept resisting.

They tased him once more and they were finally able to get him into handcuffs.

That's when they noticed that the suspect had lost consciousness. Without missing a beat, they immediately began life-saving tactics and radioed for an ambulance to respond with high priority.

The suspect was rushed to the hospital - but despite the prompt medical attention, he was declared dead on arrival.

According to the medical examiner, Javier Ambler's "morbid obesity" had given him "congestive heart failure" and "hyper intensive cardiovascular disease," - which, in the heat of the struggle, caused his death.

Soon after, an internal affairs investigation by my son's department found that the deputies did nothing wrong. A second independent investigation by the Austin Police Department concluded my son and the other officers committed no such crimes and did not cause Ambler's death.

**But two years after being cleared, James was charged with manslaughter!**

So what changed?

Well, Travis County - where the suspect crashed and the chase concluded - elected a new District Attorney.

A George Soros-funded District Attorney . . . a Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren-endorsed District Attorney . . . a socialist District Attorney, who campaigned not on fighting crime - but on cracking down on police.

His name is Jose Garza, and in just over three years in office, he's charged dozens of cops with crimes while letting countless violent criminals go free!

Somehow, my son James got caught up in something much bigger than himself, and now he's lost his job and his life savings trying to defend his good name in court.

Worst of all, if convicted James's children will lose their dad to decades in prison.

**[Now I hope you can see why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you to help me fight for my son - and my grandchildren - by supporting James' legal defense.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoma8kh97dfaaup5jdqn48po45sou2m8tv59r4ag_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi6eob2cth2bs)**

You see, right when we thought all hope was lost - we got a call from Jason Johnson at the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

This incredible organization helps innocent cops who are unfairly prosecuted for split-second, life-or-death decisions they make in the line of duty.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses. . . whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court.

And they do it all free of charge!

They're funded entirely by the generous support of big-hearted donors like you, who can recognize a miscarriage of justice. . . and want to help fix it.

My son has told me he feels abandoned by the people he dedicated his life to helping. I told him there are people out there who still support the police...

...and I pray you are one of these people and that you will step up and help to fund the $150,000+ in legal fees he's facing.

**[Will you please help my son clear his name by making a generous tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to LELDF today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7t030rqcg2osfnaotlfn62ulrftb4b0ei8nqf1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi6eob2cth2bs)**

No matter how much you can give to help LELDF fund James' defense, I hope you'll know how grateful I - and my entire family - will be for your help.

With deep appreciation,

**Karen Dabney**

P.S. My son has four children of his own. If James is convicted and receives the maximum sentence of 20 years, they'll be grown adults by the time he's finally set free. He will miss out on everything. And his children will grow up without a dad.

**[So, please- PLEASE - won't you send the best donation you can today to help keep my brave son out of prison and with his children, where he belongs?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsqferf3lllo92r7a7d0qfd2fn06prsqof8aduv8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi6eob2cth2bs)** Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!
\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mJFae2uiRB3DXbtlty9_nA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnk6HqP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMTI0VwNzcGNCCmWirgaxZQoqjrpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mJFae2uiRB3DXbtlty9_nA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnk6HqP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMTI0VwNzcGNCCmWirgaxZQoqjrpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mJFae2uiRB3DXbtlty9_nA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnk6HqP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMTI0VwNzcGNCCmWirgaxZQoqjrpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Dear Peter,
While we appreciate the headline news, _the reality is_ our campaign is not counting on winning the Presidential election via vote taken by the U.S. House of Representatives.
_Our aim is to win the election outright, as an Independent candidate, on November 5, 2024—in just over 9 months_.
Winning on Election Day, and being declared the winner on Election Day, should be the goal of every candidate.
Sadly, our current election process mirrors that of a banana republic, in some instances, rather than that of the United States Republic.
Often we don’t know who won an election until months after our votes have been cast and the winner is declared only after multiple recounts and court orders.
Bottom line: Our campaign, despite the odds, seeks to win the election on Election Day.
But the key to winning is you.
Your actions today are crucial to protecting the “republic for which it stands.”
Your actions today will help secure a prosperous and free future for your children and grandchildren.
And you know as well as we do that no one is coming to save us.
That’s why we’re writing to you.
Without you, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. will not appear on the ballot in 50 states.
With your support, he will.
Without you, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. will not be on the debate stage.
With your support, he will.
So we must move beyond the wild speculations of canceling the election or hoping the House of Representatives will decide who our next President is—and embrace the reality that our real opportunity to win lies with you.
You are our path to victory on Election Day. _Your support will help to ensure Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. receives more votes than either Biden or Trump._

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrp7s3njmtlhf00fsehd1i169h3jqmsmc7sk7nk8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi69oj2cph2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zafv0qhvr5iu7tlj2jnvrct5puklc951uvndadf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi69oj2cph2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9df5idb2s7ma0b5qbfbcn03bjir5av6es1jdep8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chi69oj2cph2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: A Resounding Victory for Life in Indiana!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Suzanne Crouch
body:
On Sanctity of Human Life Day, thousands of courageous individuals gathered to champion the cause of life, and it was an honor to stand among you.

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=407e8cf826-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_23_08_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-407e8cf826-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

This week's March for Life was a resounding victory for life in Indiana! Thousands of courageous individuals gathered in Indianapolis on Sanctity of Human Life Day to champion the cause of life, and it was a profound honor to stand among you.

Under my leadership, Indiana has become one of the most pro-life states in the country and, as your Governor, I️ will ensure it remains so.

** We have achieved critical victories
------------------------------------------------------------

Together, we have achieved critical victories, including the Supreme Court setting aside Roe v. Wade and the 2022 special session where I cast a tie-breaking vote to strengthen abortion laws.

Plus, we increased funding for mothers, babies, and families, and we enshrined into law our belief that innocent human life is sacred.

** Celebrating the gift of life!
------------------------------------------------------------

We must not only fight to protect life, but also celebrate the victories for life. One such victory happened earlier this week, when I️ was a part of a news conference announcing the first baby surrendered to a Safe Haven Baby Box in Indiana this year (https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=407e8cf826-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_23_08_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-407e8cf826-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=407e8cf826-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_23_08_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-407e8cf826-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

My heartfelt thanks go to the courageous parent who made this profoundly difficult and selfless decision.

This surrender is a powerful victory for life, showcasing the effectiveness of the Safe Haven Baby Box program in saving innocent children's lives.

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

As we continue this critical fight for life, let us never forget that our strength lies in each other and the millions of Hoosiers and Americans who stand with us.

It's with both respect and gratitude that I salute the commitment and tireless advocacy of all of Indiana's pro-life groups. I am with you, and I will never falter when it comes to protecting our state's legacy of life.

Friends and fellow Hoosiers, This week's March for Life was a resounding victory for life in Indiana! Thousands of courageous individuals gathered in Indianapolis on Sanctity of Human Life Day to champion the cause of life, and it was a profound honor to stand among you. Under my leadership, Indiana has become one of the most pro-life states in the country and, as your Governor, I️ will ensure it remains so. We have achieved critical victories Together, we have achieved critical victories, including the Supreme Court setting aside Roe v. Wade and the 2022 special session where I cast a tie-breaking vote to strengthen abortion laws. Plus, we increased funding for mothers, babies, and families, and we enshrined into law our belief that innocent human life is sacred. Celebrating the gift of life! We must not only fight to protect life, but also celebrate the victories for life. One such victory happened earlier this week, when I️ was a part of a news conference announcing the first baby surrendered to a Safe Haven Baby Box in Indiana this year () . My heartfelt thanks go to the courageous parent who made this profoundly difficult and selfless decision. This surrender is a powerful victory for life, showcasing the effectiveness of the Safe Haven Baby Box program in saving innocent children's lives. Last but not least... As we continue this critical fight for life, let us never forget that our strength lies in each other and the millions of Hoosiers and Americans who stand with us. It's with both respect and gratitude that I salute the commitment and tireless advocacy of all of Indiana's pro-life groups. I am with you, and I will never falter when it comes to protecting our state's legacy of life. God bless you all, Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. | | Dear fellow citizen,
Over 700 years ago, Dante Alighieri was exiled from his beloved Florence. Stripped of his property, he spent the rest of his life as a guest in foreign places.
While in exile, Dante wrote one of the greatest epic poems, _The Divine Comedy_. Taking an imaginary journey through the three realms of the afterlife—Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise—he encounters old enemies and cherished friends, crooked politicians and great statesmen, infamous sinners, and holy saints.
The result is a profound education in character, as the poet learns how to order his soul to lead a free and happy life. And _The Divine Comedy_ is a delight to read.
**This is why Hillsdale College has produced an online course, “Dante’s _Divine Comedy,_ ” about this monumental work of literature. **
---
| | And now, the course about this timeless masterpiece is available on DVD for your home library, Bible study, or book club.
You can receive the DVD of **“Dante’s _Divine Comedy_ ” **in a handsome box set for a gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale and its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, like free online courses.
We**** produce our free online courses, as we do all of our work, without accepting ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f38fda093a024c68a9b9fc337746c909&_e=YT-7Fz3cTeV-b-gOsefXVKbN-jgUyzRZ5joNGOz_t3sVpxWCcq2nJxI_4JAyPtSj9i-blOp4xK_aMPXpPzvEi0cW_Ghdna4whh-CD9b-vAVtOgksaW1AJY13D8kFjXVB44FLMxeN7PwGur8dHHiEuQMZ3ci2bNCfdiCIw-g0ShQ4XqROhGqmLzDGxpyVYoqT6WbzZ5gS32LjMwvd9bBpckAiUETxpfBAJGQ_-4gAigo8grzQE28mJWS_2eOCpCmHfXqvmL1J2qkUynZZ-KddvezmSwkHdzYevSxhfmsofH8h4z5I1UqYOfmAT212KtZZ838lb_2QqeOksT74wjn6Tozh30DEF_JK5767-tVRNS5Yk5An8gM-iNmhnsbUP8dtE_Sv6MHHmqvM4A4lhTdQDA%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f38fda093a024c68a9b9fc337746c909&_e=YT-7Fz3cTeV-b-gOsefXVKbN-jgUyzRZ5joNGOz_t3sVpxWCcq2nJxI_4JAyPtSj9i-blOp4xK_aMPXpPzvEi0cW_Ghdna4whh-CD9b-vAVtOgksaW1AJY13D8kFjXVB44FLMxeN7PwGur8dHHiEuQMZ3ci2bNCfdiCIw-g0ShQ4XqROhGqmLzDGxpyVYoqT6WbzZ5gS32LjMwvd9bBpckAiUETxpfBAJGQ_-4gAigo8grzQE28mJWS_2eOCpCmH42plzKsgckhdDP-btllvOWFgH119holsi-zv6vu8_dq085L2D341_chOSnQ6WnHSQ0ytD8uu0bDmVD1eIcNO_3LEiI6cpYkz9xSiDkW9P1pVAgCpiOZSCoLRfelMTdkiSPWKy89jTL8gx39xdQqI9g%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f38fda093a024c68a9b9fc337746c909&_e=YT-7Fz3cTeV-b-gOsefXVKbN-jgUyzRZ5joNGOz_t3sVpxWCcq2nJxI_4JAyPtSj9i-blOp4xK_aMPXpPzvEi0cW_Ghdna4whh-CD9b-vAVtOgksaW1AJY13D8kFjXVB44FLMxeN7PwGur8dHHiEuQMZ3ci2bNCfdiCIw-g0ShQ4XqROhGqmLzDGxpyVYoqT6WbzZ5gS32LjMwvd9bBpckAiUETxpfBAJGQ_-4gAigo8grzQE28mJWS_2eOCpCmHtBqgvx-cwW8Xl09Ld-9NJ9YN0rZlbndg9NzKj13cJ5dZ8CmYAprSnYnIjg9LEWSgW4uqWqanFLpN2WjYhKZivF_zJONzhC7lxJ98ACkQxRmdr-73aBO-Fy1FvVU5PKY4-0v62iy8h-aRLecFcrlc0A%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f38fda093a024c68a9b9fc337746c909&_e=YT-7Fz3cTeV-b-gOsefXVKbN-jgUyzRZ5joNGOz_t3sVpxWCcq2nJxI_4JAyPtSj9i-blOp4xK_aMPXpPzvEi0cW_Ghdna4whh-CD9b-vAVtOgksaW1AJY13D8kFjXVB44FLMxeN7PwGur8dHHiEuQMZ3ci2bNCfdiCIw-g0ShQ4XqROhGqmLzDGxpyVYoqT6WbzZ5gS32LjMwvd9bBpckAiUETxpfBAJGQ_-4gAigo8grzQE28mJWS_2eOCpCmHCpubL5O-H2tvxLVbKcz1bfTrTwsP00t721tz94UobrlwMIa_n14mu1fVA0p0EyaFU4bIHWb2pFLjuKG6ReWiRSwGtbJzz-Z2RbGH9Ls8JilkpoyQX808atXZsxSfU7oiP6-BD0OOPdvZ65bmhEgztQ%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1058%2E135344%2EJoFm4u)

Friends -
Last night Donald Trump won the New Hampshire Republican Primary. With his victory, he has all but wrapped up his party's nomination for president. Next state is South Carolina, and if Nikki Haley fails to win even in her home state where she was governor, most assess that Trump will have, sadly, secured the GOP nomination.
That's why we're writing to ask you to contribute $3 to Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan today. Especially today.
Trump winning sets up a rematch with President Biden, and the threat of a Trump victory means keeping the Senate is more important than ever. So we’re asking for $3 today to help gird ourselves for what’s coming.
$3 because control of the White House and the United States Senate will all come down to who wins in Michigan. We need to hold each and every seat – minus West Virginia – to keep the Senate blue.
$3 because if Elissa can win this Senate race, we know that means it will be nearly impossible for Donald Trump to also carry the state.
$3 because Republicans know this too, and it's why they will pour tremendous amounts of money into the state to defeat us. In fact, we’ve seen dark money conservative groups up on TV with ads.
We know that $3 may not seem like it can win a Senate race and a presidential campaign, but by the time you read this lots and lots of people have contributed their $3 to keep Michigan BLUE in November.
Now they're hoping you'll do the same. Because there's only one way we'll win this race, hold the Senate, and keep Donald Trump out of the White House ... together.

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f52d501a385e47bba0fbfe4b9e909796&_e=PH3MX94aF3F0-ZL_2mriA2Gcmo1CW98c4icEZsmf7JnbFsOgzGCHCSmpOP4xJRnah-F6wv8jfLqKOwxYv5O1CyDLSHoJL875g7o59u7IVhFgc1043EEANM8XaqAnI6_g2rZj1-UirJ8a5QBL9GWudPAcHFDG44FeqRE-FBDNDfTZR2FHwxHCzbjzNHIbWS8np_bA9guaF9yrm13stAzPX4VgPyVlXt0spaT3gHwozLqR6lZ7yvry5A32fTr2-gA7JU3EVYcICrW_y6jfY3-l5Elp4HQhBoyhgC6pDcQW6NZKuv0FcAkjVtdpF47NDy3ehGmMLGmRxAejSJl7q-Kvjhch679r9HAzETyAO-EFwm87JL3p1-dvcOyDHUVVjkiRONXqbIKaRrbFezmNhxa5Ig%3D%3D)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f52d501a385e47bba0fbfe4b9e909796&_e=PH3MX94aF3F0-ZL_2mriA2Gcmo1CW98c4icEZsmf7JnbFsOgzGCHCSmpOP4xJRnah-F6wv8jfLqKOwxYv5O1CyDLSHoJL875g7o59u7IVhFgc1043EEANM8XaqAnI6_g2rZj1-UirJ8a5QBL9GWudPAcHFDG44FeqRE-FBDNDfTZR2FHwxHCzbjzNHIbWS8np_bA9guaF9yrm13stAzPX4VgPyVlXt0spaT3gHwozLqR6lZ7yvry5A32fTr2-gA7PEteEL1WNt1wRIYt8VB6RfiBuvFRk3e22qLTLUVldY_qu5F2Bi0c0JbBuhjtEwKj92hNTrb35EVjXDnC3nJrU19XpIAgay3Fv_WD6jS6iJnZYEkz8Hqvlfiu64-J4J9Eg904yQfOeRDB-CDhJYRf2w%3D%3D) [NO](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f52d501a385e47bba0fbfe4b9e909796&_e=PH3MX94aF3F0-ZL_2mriA2Gcmo1CW98c4icEZsmf7JnbFsOgzGCHCSmpOP4xJRnah-F6wv8jfLqKOwxYv5O1CyDLSHoJL875g7o59u7IVhFgc1043EEANM8XaqAnI6_g2rZj1-UirJ8a5QBL9GWudPAcHFDG44FeqRE-FBDNDfTZR2FHwxHCzbjzNHIbWS8np_bA9guaF9yrm13stAzPX4VgPyVlXt0spaT3gHwozLqR6lZ7yvry5A32fTr2-gA7VNSaP0fhpyHdz4BLnqHZha5KXKBZFuhHpaguMXcxREcVbMJdRjaA7IilR8RM0eWNHGHwQHeSZxrza_eccQIqcLCMYzBOgPVurlXgLXsbAoWizok3sEInXO_eVZJ72oISJoh8RVTDMSTYrf1Vq5kuzA%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f52d501a385e47bba0fbfe4b9e909796&_e=PH3MX94aF3F0-ZL_2mriA2Gcmo1CW98c4icEZsmf7JnbFsOgzGCHCSmpOP4xJRnah-F6wv8jfLqKOwxYv5O1CyDLSHoJL875g7o59u7IVhFgc1043EEANM8XaqAnI6_g2rZj1-UirJ8a5QBL9GWudPAcHFDG44FeqRE-FBDNDfTZR2FHwxHCzbjzNHIbWS8np_bA9guaF9yrm13stAzPX4VgPyVlXt0spaT3gHwozLqR6lZ7yvry5A32fTr2-gA7LsByTZT2Vlz7sWs50x4XHtWMMAMBHSO14TgYf72dXQKfCmSvMxTxZybF_ygEAMDi_Z6KoC4iKumM7bTwGcI9VQzhq9dRXNLcMTgJ6nyRQWeCb3mXBIABMqe53w1NzkaHG730gvM6d9zXyZLSQc82vg%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f52d501a385e47bba0fbfe4b9e909796&_e=PH3MX94aF3F0-ZL_2mriA2Gcmo1CW98c4icEZsmf7JnbFsOgzGCHCSmpOP4xJRnah-F6wv8jfLqKOwxYv5O1CyDLSHoJL875g7o59u7IVhFgc1043EEANM8XaqAnI6_g2rZj1-UirJ8a5QBL9GWudPAcHFDG44FeqRE-FBDNDfTZR2FHwxHCzbjzNHIbWS8np_bA9guaF9yrm13stAzPX4VgPyVlXt0spaT3gHwozLqR6lZ7yvry5A32fTr2-gA7vqbyFWs1uFqjLQUcY7pI-Yef62NC_3R-vna0hRf2PkRezMaB3oGJbJ5eNlGDNxk_TtgaVL7D8cydHNpfTx0Ve1f-_jXLxtK851m1-MMlV1PZnmsANisJJFU278qR_HVx7jJtsCxAq1hz4iU4PtpLGA%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

The Sandy Hook shooting was a moment of national reckoning. Americans knew then that something must be done to stop horrific shootings like this one from ever happening again. **But in the 11 years since then, the gun lobby has worked overtime to block the commonsense reforms that would have stopped future mass shootings.**

subject: Adam has been my brother since I was 7

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5208%2E5257348%2EGKF0Gq ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

My name is David McMillan, and I’m Adam Schiff’s Little Brother.

Adam’s campaign is releasing an ad on TV this week that gives me the
opportunity to tell millions of undecided California voters about my Big
Brother, and how he’ll fight for us in the U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240124_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5208%2E5257348%2EGKF0Gq ]With just a few weeks left in the U.S. Senate primary, will you chip in
to help keep this ad on the air? Any amount you give will make a big
difference.

Now, I hope you’ll allow me a few moments to talk about my relationship
with Adam and what’s at stake in this election.

When I was five years old, my mother took me to the Big Brothers of
Greater Los Angeles office in Los Angeles and helped me fill out an
application. After waiting two years to hear back, I was lucky enough to
meet Adam, who had just moved to LA.

Adam and I paired up for a day, a kind of trial run, and Adam brought me
to the beach in Venice where he was living at the time. After an afternoon
battling the crashing waves and having a blast, we dubbed ourselves The
Survivors. It was an incredible day and the start of one of the most
important relationships in my life.

After being on a waiting list, I finally had a Big Brother.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240124_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5208%2E5257348%2EGKF0Gq ]Adam Schiff and his Little Brother David McMillan

Adam has been an important part of my life since that day on the beach —
he was with me when I graduated from Yale, and I was with him when he
married his wife, Eve. We have a similar sense of humor, and we both have
a big appreciation for film (which is why I’m now a TV writer and why Adam
always quotes The Big Lebowski).

I might be biased, but I know that Adam will make us proud as California’s
next Senator.

We’ve seen it in the work he’s done over the years. From writing
California’s patient bill of rights to protecting our rule of law from
Trump, Adam puts in the work to make a difference and make our state a
better place for everyone.

Adam is the kind of person we need more of in the Senate. Someone who will
always fight to do the right thing — even if it’s not always the easy
thing.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240124_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=5208%2E5257348%2EGKF0Gq ]With just a few weeks until the primary election, please support my
brother Adam’s campaign for the U.S. Senate. Any amount you give will make
a big difference. Thank you for chipping in what you can.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=jan2024_abs_em.eamPKe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240124_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1007&akid=5208%2E5257348%2EGKF0Gq ]EXPRESS DONATE

body:
| | As a doctor, I focus on the facts backed by science and data, and here's the truth, Peter: **In Texas, our healthcare outcomes are some of the worst in the nation.**

In 2021, nearly 20% of Texans were uninsured. Texas children were more than twice as likely as children in other states to be uninsured. Texas also ranks #49 in the nation for women’s healthcare.

From the frontlines in our hospitals, I've seen how our broken healthcare system fails so many in need — I’m determined to find solutions. That’s why I went to Congress to serve as a Health Policy Advisor where I fought alongside Speaker Pelosi to deliver better care and lower costs for all Americans. [**Before I share my plan, I’m asking for your help with a donation to my campaign >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77638238/451055480/-1417367329?refcode=em24_240123_hcRS_fndd_gq_nopn___dbw_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240123_hcRS_fndd_gq_nopn___dbw_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=44b31465-cbba-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDRiMzE0NjUtY2JiYS1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yphUihIgtCulIKutL8T_6tgzsYBH4CjRoK68zfrJkUU=)

* Offer a public option for health insurance so Americans will have expanded access and more choices in the marketplace.

name: Dr. Annie Andrews
subject: It’s time to stop the games
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THEIR FUTURE PAC
body:
| | |
---
Republican legislators in South Carolina would have you believe gender-affirming care is the greatest threat facing our children. Why else would they open the 2024 legislative session by passing a bill that will ban this life-saving, evidence-based care?

**_Gender-affirming care is not a threat at all, actually. But banning it is._** As a mom, a pediatrician, and founder of Their Future PAC, our nation’s first Political Action Committee dedicated to building a brighter future for our children, I can tell you, with confidence, our children face a multitude of actual threats. And they need help, not bullying, from our legislators.

Gun violence, climate change, attacks on public education, hunger, homelessness, and a mental health crisis, are just a few of the threats our youngest generation faces. Serious people, who actually care about children, understand this. Ask a teacher who buys their own school supplies while politicians call them groomers. Ask a trauma surgeon who wears blood-soaked scrubs from a child with bullet holes while legislators work to pass dangerous gun laws like permitless carry. Ask a parent who can’t afford their child’s asthma inhalers while our Governor refuses to expand Medicaid, ask a school-based mental health professional who can’t meet the needs of their student body, while legislators ignore our youth mental health crisis. The moment for children in this country has never been more urgent. The threats they face are as numerous as they are profound. But you would never know it by watching our SC Republican supermajority.

Gender-affirming care refers to medical, psychological, and social support that helps individuals align their gender expression with their gender identity, promoting a sense of authenticity and well-being. It is supported by all major medical organizations. Banning it will harm vulnerable transgender youth and is a direct affront to parents’ rights. The Republican Governor of Ohio, Mike DeWine, put it best when he said (after vetoing a gender-affirming care ban) “Were I to sign House Bill 68, Ohio would be saying that the state, that the government, knows better what is medically best for a child, than the two people that love that child the most, the parents.”

Some of them do it because they want to score political points in their gerrymandered districts. It has to stop. These games hurt real families and children in South Carolina and sadly, this is happening all across the country. Meanwhile, our kids actually need their help. They need better gun laws, more affordable healthcare, access to mental health services, food security, and quality public education.

Republicans aren’t protecting kids. They are playing a cynical game. A cynical game that hurts vulnerable children while ignoring the threats facing all of our children. We must hold them accountable, call them out and most importantly, vote them out.

Peter.

Tim Kaine has spent his life wearing a fancy suit.

As a lawyer and a career politician, his uniform is shiny shoes and a too-tight tie.

**During my career, my uniform was a little bit different.**

Every day, I put on my body armor or dive gear to serve as a Special Operations Officer in the United States Navy.

body:
We are on the ballot! This campaign continues to build momentum in its quest to redefine American politics, guided by the principles of truth, love and justice for all.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=psQUkJGc26u6Wi0imicX-00jZnUVaZYVu06OFU-xtOc&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oregon2&n=1)

### Dr. Cornel West Secures Ballot Access in Oregon with Progressive Party’s Support
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **Wednesday, January 24th, 2024**
Cornel West for President
[press@cornelwest2024.com](mailto:Press@cornelwest2024.com) Independent presidential candidate Dr. Cornel West, in collaboration with Oregon's Progressive Party ([ProgParty.org](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=uyNuF5YdQ5a_Wn5Y74zQmPsBDe0NanvcwMV2M032DTI&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oregon2&n=2)), has secured ballot access in Oregon for the 2024 US Presidential Election, marking a significant milestone in his campaign. West stated, "We are striving for a society where the needs of the many outweigh the interests of the few, where the environment is protected, where poverty is eradicated, where foreign policy is founded on the use of diplomacy, not war, and where every voice is heard through proportional representation voting.” He added, “ It's a profound honor to be listed on Oregon's ballot for 2024 as part of the Oregon Progressive Party slate of candidates. I am deeply thankful to my Oregonian family for embracing this vision. Oregon, you are not just on the map, you are at the forefront of the struggle for truth and justice.”
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=10&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oregon2&n=3)
---
In line with the Oregon Progressive Party's core values, Brother West's campaign will emphasize several key issues: establishing a state bank to support local communities and small businesses, promoting a single-payer Medicare for All system to ensure medical care for all Oregonians, with an emphasis on increasing access to and justice in healthcare, and enhancing environmental protections with a focus on sustainability as well as climate and environmental justice. In explaining their new partnership with the Cornel West 2024 campaign, the Oregon Progressive Party proclaimed, “We are proud to support Dr. West. He embodies the principles we stand for - healthcare as a human right, free public education, environmental justice, and a peaceful approach to foreign policy.” They continued, “Oregonians have always been progressive at heart, and with Dr. West, we have a candidate who truly represents our values and vision for the future. We are confident that his candidacy will resonate with the citizens of Oregon and make a significant impact in the presidential race.”
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=27&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oregon2&n=4 "DONATE NOW >>") [DONATE NOW >>](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=27&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oregon2&n=4)
---
The West campaign will collaborate closely with the Oregon Progressive Party to highlight the importance of public banking, advocating for the establishment of a state bank to support local economies and provide accessible financial services to underserved communities. This initiative aims to keep Oregon's financial resources within the state, promoting economic growth and stability while also ensuring the resources are utilized to address a growing wealth and income inequality challenge statewide. Brother West's commitment to healthcare reform is also a cornerstone of his campaign. In alignment with the Oregon Progressive Party's position, he advocates for a single-payer healthcare system, emphasizing the need for universal access to quality and affordable healthcare. This approach aims to alleviate the burden of medical costs on individuals and families, ensuring that all Oregonians receive the care they need. Leading national, state, and local climate and environmental justice groups have already offered high marks for Brother West’s policy pillars for environmental justice that include centering those communities most impacted by the climate crisis and legacy environmental racism, as well as measures to protect Oregon's natural beauty and resources. He calls for immediate action to combat climate change and promote sustainable practices, aligning with the party's focus on environmental stewardship and climate justice. This includes supporting renewable energy initiatives and opposing fossil fuel projects that exacerbate harms to environmental justice communities. Brother West is the only presidential candidate calling for going beyond a milquetoast version of the so-called Green New Deal and instead a global Green Reconstruction initiative that includes nationalizing the fossil fuel industry. He also promises to rescind the toxic elements of Joe Biden and the Democratic Party’s Inflation Reduction Act that’s already handed out billions of dollars to polluters who back projects like Jordan Cove, further reflecting a commitment to preserving Oregon's ecological integrity for future generations. Reflecting on the broader implications of this partnership, Dr. West said, “Aligning with the Oregon Progressive Party is not just about being on the ballot; we are bringing our collective voices to the forefront of the national dialogue. Our shared goals - from healthcare for all, to urgent action for a growing climate crisis, and a commitment to peace - are not just Oregon's issues - they are everyone’s issues, nationwide. I am honored to join forces with them and eagerly anticipate working together to win the State of Oregon come November.” With this significant development in Oregon, the Cornel West 2024 campaign continues to build momentum in its quest to redefine American politics, guided by the principles of truth, love and justice for all. **About Oregon Progressive Party:** The Oregon Progressive Party is a political organization committed to advancing social and economic justice, environmental sustainability, and government accountability, firmly grounded in the values of grassroots democracy and progressive change.
---

name: Medhini Kumar, Evergreen
subject: We shouldn't pay for power companies to fight climate action.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
The more I learned about dirty utilities, the more I wanted to hold them accountable
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/339?t=2&akid=14014%2E53494%2EEeLc7t)
---
| | Hi There, I'm Medhini, and I'm the writer/editor at Evergreen. If you're like my parents, you might be wondering what that _actually_ means. Essentially, I get to spend my day learning and writing about the climate challenges our communities face—and the bold, actionable solutions that we urgently need to build a better future.

Last year, I wrote about how it's not just Big Oil and their cronies holding us back from the promise of a clean energy economy. **Dirty utilities** are just as bad. They are not only **actively lobbying against climate action, but they're using money pulled from _our_ monthly energy bills to fund _their_ destructive agenda. **

The more I learned, the more I couldn't stop wondering what we—paying customers and climate advocates—could do about it.

That's why [I'm really excited to share with you the latest piece I've gotten to work on.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5118?t=3&akid=14014%2E53494%2EEeLc7t) **It offers a solution:** A new bill could bring much-needed utility accountability to California—and serve as a roadmap for other states to follow.
---
[**SEE HOW**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5118?t=5&akid=14014%2E53494%2EEeLc7t)
---
Researching for this piece, I was shocked by the sheer scale of utility malfeasance. **Power companies are charging customers tens of millions of dollars to bankroll their anti-climate campaigns** , binding their customers to expensive, unreliable fossil energy sources. So, while families are working hard to pay their energy bills, a meaningful chunk of their money is actually working against them to promote climate denial—not providing them with power.
---
[READ NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5118?t=7&akid=14014%2E53494%2EEeLc7t)
---
We deserve public utilities that actually serve the public, not their own political interests. **[It's time to close the loopholes once and for all.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5118?t=8&akid=14014%2E53494%2EEeLc7t) **

Onward,

Medhini Kumar
Writer/Editor
Evergreen Action
---
|
---

That's why It offers a solution: A new bill could bring much-needed utility accountability to California—and serve as a roadmap for other states to follow. Researching for this piece, I was shocked by the sheer scale of utility malfeasance. Power companies are charging customers tens of millions of dollars to bankroll their anti-climate campaigns , binding their customers to expensive, unreliable fossil energy sources. So, while families are working hard to pay their energy bills, a meaningful chunk of their money is actually working against them to promote climate denial—not providing them with power. We deserve public utilities that actually serve the public, not their own political interests. Onward, Medhini Kumar Writer/Editor Evergreen Action | P.S. Through educational pieces, public accountability campaigns, and targeted advocacy, Evergreen is working hard to hold utility providers and our administration accountable to their climate pledges and the people they serve. | | | | | | ---|---|---|---

Recently my team and I sent you an email asking for you to help us better understand the direction which the Republican Party is headed. subject: School choice means Education Freedom Accounts for everyone
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/successsequence-11571612?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**It’s official! Governor Tate Reeves has signed a declaration making this week School Choice Week in Mississippi.**

It is not just the Governor that supports school choice. **A recent poll showed around eight out of ten Mississippians do, too. **
CLICK IMAGE BELOW FOR UPDATE ON OUR STRATEGY TO ACHIEVE SCHOOL CHOICE – AND MORE
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=f0fe41b32d&e=5703353baa)
---
| Giving families the right to use state money to get their children the education that suits their own needs is wildly popular. **According to Arc Insights, both Democrats (73 percent) and Republicans (84 percent) back the idea.**

**School choice in Mississippi means giving every family Arkansas-style Education Freedom Accounts.** That would mean any family that wanted to take part in the program receiving a deposit equal to about 90 percent of the prior year’s average net public school aid per student.

**In other words, school choice means something very specific.** This matters because people that would rather not allow parents control over their child’s share of education money, often imply that school choice somehow stops short of Education Freedom Accounts. Or they imply school choice means something else.
---
|
---
| Mississippi parents love charter schools, which is why the handful that we have been allowed are oversubscribed. **But even if we trebled the number of Charter Schools in the state, we would still not be giving enough families meaningful choice.**

Broadening the choice of courses available for high schoolers is a good idea. It would help prepare young people for the world of work. **But promising a wider range of choices within the system is not the same as allowing families to decide where their share of tax dollars goes.**

**Some suggest that school choice is good – but only in areas where school boards are rated D or F. If that was the case, there would only be choice in half a dozen districts.** The whole point about school choice is that it should be for mom and dad to rate the education options available, not bureaucrats. School choice means Education Freedom for everyone!

**The exciting news is that the voting public understands all this. A recent poll showed 3 in 4 Mississippians not only want school choice, but they specifically want Education Freedom Accounts.**
---
|
---
| It is great to see momentum building for school choice in this state. That has to mean Education Freedom Accounts available to everyone.

**Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders, who lead the fight for school choice in Arkansas, called herself****"a change-maker, not a caretaker of the status quo". Mississippi needs school choice, too. **

Have a wonderful School Choice Week!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=6c99c3188f&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

**Mark Green Endorses Teichert for U.S. Senate: “A Proven Leader”**
**BALTIMORE, MD.** \-- John Teichert, a retired Air Force Brigadier General and candidate for the open U.S. Senate seat in Maryland, is thrilled to continue the new year with yet another endorsement; this one on behalf of Congressman Mark Green (TN-07), Chair of the House Committee on Homeland Security.
In a statement, Chairman Green shared why he is choosing to endorse John Teichert this election season, stating, “As Chair of the House Committee on Homeland Security, I see our critical need for national security experts in Congress every single day. General Teichert is a proven leader, a keen innovator, a decorated veteran, and a national security expert who has served our country with honor, distinction, and oversized impact.”
The Congressman goes on to say of General Teichert, “He understands the pressing challenges we face at home and abroad and has the vision and courage to tackle them. He will be a strong voice for Maryland and a staunch defender for liberty and national security in the U.S. Senate.”
Chairman Green’s endorsement follows a plethora of support flooding in for General Teichert, including that of Maryland state leaders and law enforcement officials. General Teichert is fighting for a change in Washington D.C., one that elects leaders not politicians, who are focused on providing opportunity and safety for people across the great state of Maryland.

In 2023, House Republicans passed legislation to REDUCE inflation, LOWER energy costs, PAY DOWN our nation’s debt, secure our border & give parents MORE say in their children’s education.

| | | Hi Friend,

I hope this message finds you well and thriving in our vibrant community. As someone deeply committed to the collective well-being and progress of our CA-34 community, I believe in the power of unity and active participation. It is through our combined efforts and shared voices that we can truly shape the future we envision for ourselves and for those who will follow.

_**Community: The Heart of Change**_

In our journey towards building a better tomorrow, the role of community cannot be overstated. It is in the community where we find strength, support, and a sense of belonging. By coming together, we not only share our individual stories but also weave a richer tapestry of collective experiences and aspirations. It is in these gatherings that ideas are born, voices are heard, and actions are inspired.

To that end, I wanted to let you know of a few upcoming events and opportunities to connect.

I am thrilled to invite you to two special events this week:

---

**Date:** Thursday, January 25
**Time:** 7:00pm PST

**Details:** Join us for an engaging live discussion with the remarkable Gina Viola, where we'll discuss Single Payer Healthcare and the transformative change that can happen when we come together to elect the right people.
---
| |
---
| _**Community Listening Session**_

**Date:** Friday, January 26
**Time:** 5:00-7:00pm PST
**Location:**
Gladi8or Pizza & Billiards
5128 Whittier Blvd,
Los Angeles, CA 90022

**Details:** This session is all about you – your thoughts, concerns, and visions. It’s a chance to speak and be heard, to listen, and to connect with fellow community members. Your input is vital in shaping our shared path forward. **[RSVP HERE](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=99110ec668&e=fee98d637f)**.
---
| | | _**Your Voice Matters**_

Your participation in these events is more than just attendance; it is a testament to your commitment to our community's future. Whether it's through engaging in conversations on social media or sharing your perspectives in person, your involvement is invaluable.

_**Let's Connect!**_

Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or require additional information about the events. And don't forget to follow us on your preferred app (@davidkimforca) for regular updates.

Together, let's continue to nurture and empower our community, for it is in unity that our collective dreams transform into reality.

| | **🚨****UNPRECEDENTED: Bill Eigel Stripped of Veterans Committee Chairmanship and Parking Space****🚨**
* * *
In a vindictive move by senate leadership, myself and fellow Missouri Freedom Caucus members were stripped of our chairmanships (and parking spots). It has been a great honor to serve as the Chairman of the Missouri Senate Veterans, Military Affairs and Pensions Committee. As an eight-year veteran of the United States Air Force, I have always been an advocate for veterans in the Missouri Senate. Unfortunately, today the Pro Tem of the Senate, Caleb Rowden, decided to try and silence my voice for veterans due to his personal animosities.

Jefferson City is ruled by a uniparty cartel of special interests, RINOs, and Democrats, who band together to crush the voice of the people. These are the same tactics The Swamp uses against President Trump. They can strip me of my chairmanship, they can kick me off committees, they can drag my name through the mud, but I am not backing down. They think this punishment will somehow deter me, but I am freer than I have ever been. I don't work for the swamp. I work for the people, and the people are tired of spineless RINOs. We will push forward until initiative petition reform crosses the finish line - I will not stand idly by and allow Missouri's pro-life laws to be destroyed.

_**Read the backstory in the next section.**_

---

News article and link to press conferences by leadership and MO Freedom Caucus
| | **🚨****BETRAYAL: RINOs Fail to Protect the Unborn****🚨**
* * *
Last week, pro-abortion organizations announced the launch of their signature gathering efforts to do away with Missouri’s pro-life laws and enshrine the killing of unborn children into the Missouri Constitution.

The Missouri Freedom Caucus filed a motion to bring initiative petition (IP) reform to the Senate floor on Wednesday. The floor leader immediately adjourned. So, we continued our efforts and brought it to the floor again Thursday. The RINOs and Democrats in the Missouri Senate shot down our motion by a vote of 7 to 25.

Because of this, those of us in the Missouri Freedom Caucus are employing the procedural maneuvers at our disposal and are blocking all gubernatorial appointments until the Senate passes concurrent majority ratification IP reform and sends it over to the House for approval. IP reform is the single most important thing we need to pass this session to preserve Missouri's pro-life laws and stop unfettered abortion on demand from being added to our constitution.

Usually the Senate adjourns early on Thursday mornings. This week, however, the Senate was in session until 9:30PM. I joined my fellow Freedom Caucus members in filibustering for 9 hours to force leadership to move IP reform forward.

RINOs and Democrats are running our state into the ground, and we’ve got to do what it takes to stop them. Whatever it takes, we must stop abortion from being enshrined into our Missouri Constitution.

See the roll call vote below. 7 conservatives voted to bring up IP reform to defend unborn life, and 25 RINOs (Republicans In Name Only) and Democrats voted no.

I was looking forward to meeting all of you fine folks in Joplin Thursday night and answering your questions about the upcoming 2024 gubernatorial election. I am sorry we had to cancel the event. name: The GIFFORDS Team
subject: [SIGN ON] Tell Congress and the IRS to revoke the NRA’s tax-exempt status
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
It’s against the law for charitable organizations to conduct themselves in the way that the NRA has.
#

Remember the NRA’s 2019 corruption scandal, team?
_The New Yorker_ and _The Trace_ conducted an in-depth investigation and revealed the organization’s severe financial mismanagement in a major report. They found that top NRA executives were using NRA funds for their own personal benefit and evading IRS regulations.
Just days before his corruption trial was set to begin, NRA CEO Wayne LaPierre announced his resignation from his position at the beginning of this month.
Even though the NRA’s corruption was revealed in these investigations five years ago, the NRA **_still**_ holds tax-exempt status to this day.
It’s against the law for charitable organizations to conduct themselves in the way that the NRA has. The NRA doesn’t deserve its tax-exempt status.
[**If you agree, will you add your name to our petition to call on Congress and the IRS to revoke the NRA’s tax-exempt status?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_nrataxexempt_jan24/?source=em240124-1-30&refcode2=7538.3935704.SNWUBi&akid=7538%2E3935704%2ESNWUBi)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_nrataxexempt_jan24/?source=em240124-1-30&refcode2=7538.3935704.SNWUBi&akid=7538%2E3935704%2ESNWUBi)**
Thank you for taking a stand. With Wayne LaPierre’s resignation and membership at record lows, the NRA is the weakest it’s ever been. Now is the time to finally end the gun lobby’s toxic influence on our political system.
\- The GIFFORDS Team

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=7538%2E3935704%2ESNWUBi) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

---
Peter,
The 134 PAC is the largest rural Democratic organization in Texas. We represent 134 rural counties throughout the Lone Star State.
Our plan was not to endorse this cycle.
**BUT... then we met Thierry!**
Thierry didn’t lobby us. He didn’t ask for our support.
Instead, he earned it.
[**Join The 134 PAC in supporting Thierry and his grassroots campaign.**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=0068a47319&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Thierry centered rural Texas at the heart of his campaign.
He’s visited dozens of rural counties since first launching his campaign. Last week alone, Thierry visited 20 counties. His investment in ALL of Texas is visible in the number of counties he has visited so far this primary, which is more than any Democratic primary candidate running this cycle.
[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=7b5d1f6304&e=b8ba94fd9b)
He also recently released his [**Rural Bill of Rights**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=ff413acba0&e=b8ba94fd9b) laying out 11 rights that every rural American including every rural Texan should enjoy. It’s largely focused on 2 things: expanding infrastructure to support the rural communities who are the backbone of our economy and putting the needs of rural Americans above those of corporate profits.
**Based upon the track record of the candidates in the Democratic Primary for the U.S. Senate, the only one who has done what we believe needs to be done is Thierry Tchenko.** He is the only candidate for state-wide office since Ann Richards to so completely incorporate all of Texas, including rural Texas, into his campaign and made it part of his strategy. Thierry has proven his commitment to go everywhere, listen to everyone, and represent all Texans. **We urge all Democrats, especially rural Democrats to vote for Thierry Tchenko for U.S. Senate on March 5, 2024 so that we can create A New Way Forward for Texas.**
[**Kick in $20.24 or more today and join us in supporting Thierry Tchenko for U.S. Senate!**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=363db2c84a&e=b8ba94fd9b)
