Peter, this week, three Ohio Republicans debated for the chance to defeat me in the race that will decide whether Democrats defend our Senate majority or hand control back to Mitch McConnell. It'll be another two months before I know who my opponent will be, but one thing is abundantly clear after last night: All three of these Republicans would be an absolute disaster for Ohioans and our country. That's why I'm urgently asking for your support now to make sure I have the resources to defeat whichever one of them is on the ballot: All three of my potential opponents have said they'd support a national abortion ban -- and any one of them winning would be a victory for Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and their megadonor allies. Social Security, fair wages, reproductive rights -- so much of what we care about will be at risk if they flip this seat and the Senate red. That's why it's so important that we raise the resources we need to go toe to toe with the GOP. But unlike my self-funding opponents, I can't write myself a million-dollar check -- I'm counting on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory, Peter. Thank you,

subject: I don't have time for this - do you?
body:
Need to admit a hard truth to you.

Peter, I admitted a hard truth the other day to a group of conservative patriots. I'm going to tell you exactly what I told them.

Politicians from both parties - including Republicans - have been lying to us for a long time. They say one thing to us when they want our votes but become complacent in Washington.

Here's the truth: Republicans who are complacent are complicit in the problem.

I'm 36 years old. I love my country, but our border is being overrun. Our cost-of-living is unaffordable. Our national debt is in a tailspin.

I'm sorry, but I don't have time to be complacent.

Do you?

I'm running for Congress because I believe our Republican leaders need to act with URGENCY and BOLDNESS in everything they do!

We need more America First patriots in Washington willing to stand up and say enough is enough.

If you agree that we need new leadership, I have just one request for you:

ADD YOUR NAME and ENDORSE my campaign for Congress and join our movement to bring America First leadership to Washington! (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/vote-pledge?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Max_Complacent_12424)

Thank you and God bless America,

Here at Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we're passionate about our national parks – from Yellowstone's legendary geysers to the Grand Canyon’s majestic cliffs and beyond. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/77658818/451108983/2105508926?refcode=ea.86a90bd9-e5ba-ee11-b660-002248223197&ms=ea.86a90bd9-e5ba-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg2YTkwYmQ5LWU1YmEtZWUxMS1iNjYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fpqE2ai2LGkvXOsP2UKNd88Kl9yWJ0Dp6EDCUCYPvpI=) But we've got a serious situation: **these natural wonders around the country are under threat from the fossil fuel industry, especially the effects of nearby fossil fuel extraction.** There are alarming reports, like the poor air quality in Rocky Mountain National Park and disruptions of the habitat and migration routes of mule deer in Grand Teton National Park, which are directly linked to nearby oil and gas operations. We must protect our national parks — otherwise, we risk not only the destruction of natural habitats, dangerous air and water pollution, and upsetting the ecological balance, but also the desecration of thousands of sacred cultural sites. Imagine the joy of taking your grandkids to experience Yellowstone's Old Faithful or sharing the breathtaking views of the Grand Canyon with them. It's all about keeping these special places safe and unspoiled, _not just for us_ but for all the generations that follow. That's why our mission is critical. We're actively working to elect leaders up and down the ballot who understand these threats and who are committed to putting our planet FIRST, not Big Oil and Gas. We need leaders who will advocate for sustainable energy and hold corporate polluters accountable, no matter how influential they may be. **_[Every dollar you contribute directly supports our work electing leaders who are committed to this fight. clean_body: There’s no going back. | Here at Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we're passionate about our national parks – from Yellowstone's legendary geysers to the Grand Canyon’s majestic cliffs and beyond. = But we've got a serious situation: these natural wonders around the country are under threat from the fossil fuel industry, especially the effects of nearby fossil fuel extraction. There are alarming reports, like the poor air quality in Rocky Mountain National Park and disruptions of the habitat and migration routes of mule deer in Grand Teton National Park, which are directly linked to nearby oil and gas operations. We must protect our national parks — otherwise, we risk not only the destruction of natural habitats, dangerous air and water pollution, and upsetting the ecological balance, but also the desecration of thousands of sacred cultural sites. Imagine the joy of taking your grandkids to experience Yellowstone's Old Faithful or sharing the breathtaking views of the Grand Canyon with them. It's all about keeping these special places safe and unspoiled, not just for us but for all the generations that follow. That's why our mission is critical. We're actively working to elect leaders up and down the ballot who understand these threats and who are committed to putting our planet FIRST, not Big Oil and Gas. I say “policy is personal” because, for me and so many of my neighbors in the Lower Hudson Valley, it is.

I’ve seen firsthand the **indignities of our inadequate social safety net.** Growing up, my mom had to work multiple jobs just to pay the bills and keep the lights on, even while we received housing and food assistance.

I’ve personally witnessed the **immorality of this country’s health care system.** Even with bad knees, my grandmother worked well into her 70s just to cover the costs of over-priced prescription drugs and medical procedures.

With our Democratic majority, we rescued the American economy during the worst of the pandemic, lowered prescription drug costs for seniors like my grandma, passed the infrastructure law to repair our crumbling roads and bridges, and created millions of good-paying jobs.

**It was a start, but the truth is, it’s not enough.** Between outrageous housing, health care, and child care costs, to Republican efforts to ban abortion, to the gun violence epidemic, to attacks on our democracy—people in the Lower Hudson Valley don’t have time to wait for politicians to come around to the right decisions.

We need leaders ready to act.

Republicans like Mike Lawler have proven themselves hostile to the needs of working Americans. They will ban abortion, raise prescription drug prices, slash Social Security and Medicare, and end our democracy.

**We can’t let them succeed.**

He’ll use his position as the GOP’s leading presidential candidate to rake in MILLIONS from wealthy right-wing donors and dark money groups. 7. Kari Lake, Blake Masters, The Q Anon Shaman, and so many other right-wing extremists are on the ballot this year. We have to support energizing Dems to defeat them ALL and protect our democracy. 8. Kari has forged ahead as the Arizona GOP’s leading Senate candidate, even though strategists across the aisle were calling her campaign a “nightmare.” 9. Kari herself has claimed to be “Trump in a dress,” her extremism was resoundingly rejected by Arizonans once, and with a strong grassroots coalition, we can do it again. 10. Across the board, Democrats are getting things done. From Secretary Fontes making investments to secure our elections, to AG Mayes stepping up to protect Arizona’s communities from private, harmful mining, Democrats are keeping everyday folks their top priority. 11. Meanwhile, even Republicans are admitting that they’ve done nothing — Whether it’s been Chip Roy from Texas screaming on the House floor, asking his colleagues to name one productive thing they’ve done with the majority, or Byron Donald calling the Republican conference a joke, Republican legislators know that their party is the unproductive party of Donald Trump. 12. Democrats are only FIVE seats away from a pro-worker, pro-choice majority in the House. Flipping even ONE seat in Arizona could put power back in the hands of everyday folks, not the special interests that fund the GOP. 13. The GOP has proved they’re beholden to special interests, NOT the everyday folks that they swore to represent. In late December, David Schweikert (AZ-01) pushed people to begin using Ozempic as a weight-loss drug and a way to cut the deficit (Ozempic is NOT cleared by the FDA as a weight-loss solution). Then David received a contribution from Big Pharma — it’s clear who’s calling the shots. 14. Rep. Paul Gosar (AZ-09) votes with MAGA extremist, Georgia Representative Majorie Taylor Greene over 96% of the time, and recently in a campaign fundraising email lamented the lack of white recruits in the Army. 15. Rep. Andy Biggs (AZ-05), and Rep. Eli Crane (AZ-02) alongside the rest of the House Freedom Caucus threw the House into chaos last year in a move to oust the now former Speaker Kevin McCarthy. 16. The new speaker, Mike Johnson raised over $10.6 MILLION in his first quarter in leadership, and will no doubt use that money to protect seats right here in Arizona. 17. Crane is threatening to throw the House into a stalemate for the second time — when asked about the possibility of ousting Speaker Mike Johnson, he responded that it was “absolutely” a possibility. 18. Our margin of victory is even closer in the statehouse — we’re just one seat away from equal representation in the chamber, and TWO seats away from a majority that prioritizes everyday Arizonans. 19. Remember how we said Dems are getting it done? We meant it — Dems in our state legislature recently introduced legislation to ban discrimination against LGBTQ+ in hiring, housing, and public accommodations. 20. Arizona Democrats are heading into our state legislative session with Arizonans’ key priorities in mind. From protecting our water to addressing rising prescription drug costs, our legislative priorities are the kitchen-table issues that affect every Arizonan. 21. Without a strong grassroots base, we wouldn’t have elected Governor Katie Hobbs, who continues to be a servant for Arizona’s working families. More Arizonans have good-paying jobs than at any point in our state’s history. 22. Governor Hobbs is working to make sure that home ownership is affordable for Arizonans, and recently introduced the “Arizona is Home” program which will invest over $89 million dollars to develop affordable housing and address the homelessness crisis. 23. We’ll be honest , recurring, monthly contributions made up over 40% of our online contributions last quarter. We rely on a strong base of monthly donors to plan ahead and respond to anything that comes our way. 24. By making your first $24 monthly investment today, you’ll have given over $240 to support Dems in Arizona by Election Day. So please , if you’re ready to flip Arizona all the way blue this November, join our base of monthly grassroots supporters and help us fuel our strategy. | | **For Immediate Release:** January 24, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**California High School Democrats
Endorse Dave Min**
_Senator Min Is Young People’s Choice In CA-47_
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the California High School Democrats announced their endorsement of Dave Min for Congress, citing his strong Democratic values and policy experience on issues important to young voters, including abortion, gun violence, and climate change. Dave Min, a former UC Irvine law professor who has spent his career in public service and is currently serving in the California State Senate, has been a vocal advocate and remarkably effective legislator on these issues.

**“Young Democrats will be essential in next year’s fight to win back the House,”** said Nicolas Kiet Quach, President of the California High School Democrats.**“High schoolers have the energy and the values to hit the ground running for candidates we believe in, and Dave Min is certainly one of those. With a long track record of advocating for issues we care about—from abortion, to gun violence prevention, and halting the effects of climate change—we know Dave Min will be our champion in Washington, and we’re excited to offer him our support.”**

California High School Democrats (CAHSD) is a statewide political organization that serves as a gateway to political involvement for high school students. CAHSD leads hundreds of members who work from a local level to advance the values of the Democratic Party, engage fellow students in political activism, and elect Democrats to public office at the local, state, and federal level. They also participate in voter registration initiatives and other political activities.

This endorsement builds on Senator Min’s incredible momentum in his campaign to keep this seat Blue. Last week, [Min received the coveted endorsement of the Los Angeles Times](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=af6fe0dc26&e=7017cc100e). He is also endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=1700b6d146&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. name: Ellen Laitinen
subject: Peter Hernandez Campaign update
body:
Hello Everyone,

For those of you receiving this email for the first time, it's because back in 2022 you had indicated that you wanted to be involved with Peter Hernandez's campaign for congress. Peter is running again for congress and I am reaching out to see if you would be interested in being a volunteer for his 2024 run for congress.

Last week Peter began canvassing in Salinas and was well received by the homes he visited. We need to develop a strong canvassing team to help with reaching out to District 18. Peter feels strongly that it is important to make personal contact as much as possible and could use your assistance.

If you are interested in volunteering for this, please let me know.

On Sunday, January 28th from 2:30-5pm, we will be canvassing in Salinas again. We will be meeting in the parking lot of the **_Assemblies of God church at 1025 Fairview Ave, Salinas, CA 93905_** as our starting point.

At 2:30pm, Peter will give a little orientation and then pass out maps of the neighborhoods to canvas.

Peter also wanted me to extend an invitation to you for an upcoming event at the Granada Theater in downtown Morgan Hill on February 8th. The event is called the _Benito Link Candidate Forum_ and**** is scheduled to be held from 6-8:30pm. The address is:

** _Granada Theater_**
** _17440 Monterey Road_**
** _Morgan Hill, CA 95037_**

Please respond to this email if you:
* Can attend the Benito Link Candidate Forum on February 8th
* Would be willing to do some canvassing
* Would like to volunteer (Phone calling, put up signs, etc.)
* Would like to be taken off this email

Please do not "Reply all" in contacting me, just use the reply button.

Thank you for your consideration and hope you are able to come out and support Peter in his campaigning efforts!

Ellen Laitinen
Volunteer Coordinator
Peter Hernandez for Congress

subject: Add your name: Bernie is fighting Netanyahu's brutal policies in Gaza
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

President Biden has sent $250 million worth of artillery shells and other
weapons to Israel in recent weeks. The United States has sent Netanyahu
billions of dollars. The U.S. government has watched as Israel’s war in
Gaza has killed over 25,000 people.

Now, Netanyahu admits as Israel continues to bomb the Palestinian people
that he’s restricting humanitarian aid in Gaza. This war is brutal in
every way possible, and there’s no excuse for continued U.S. support for
Israel’s horrific policies.

Bernie is going all out to oppose more funding for Israel’s war. We must
join him and say no more funding, no more weapons, and no more
restrictions on humanitarian aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240124&t=1011&akid=5243%2E5885482%2ENQ0NKe ]Add your name: The Palestinian people are suffering while Congress
considers more aid for Netanyahu’s bombing campaigns. Stop the funding,
stop the weapons shipments, and press for the free flow of humanitarian
aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240124&t=1012&akid=5243%2E5885482%2ENQ0NKe ]ADD YOUR NAME

Last week, Bernie forced a vote in the Senate on an investigation into
Israeli human rights abuses that could’ve halted U.S. funding to Israel.
But the Senate voted it down.

In his efforts, Bernie did not hold back on the reality of what the U.S.
is backing in Israel, saying, “The military campaign being waged by the
right-wing Netanyahu government has led to massive destruction and
widespread civilian harm. This has been, far and away, the most intensive
bombing campaign of the 21st century.”

Calls for a permanent ceasefire have grown since the start of this war,
with Peace champions like Barbara Lee, Rashida Tlaib, and Bernie Sanders
leading the way. But at the same time, President Biden made the unilateral
decision to send more ammunition to fuel Netanyahu’s war and Congress may
be on the verge of passing a spending bill that gives Israel another $10
billion. All to a murderous regime that now admits to restricting food,
water, and medical support the people of Gaza need.

We must ensure there’s a coalition in Congress ready to say NO to more war
funding for Israel.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240124&t=1013&akid=5243%2E5885482%2ENQ0NKe ]Will you add your name to stand with Bernie and urge Congress to oppose
all support for Israel’s brutal war and restrictions of aid in Gaza?

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

name: Wes Moore
subject: Abortion care is health care.
body:
Friend,

On January 22, 1973, the Supreme Court issued its landmark decision in Roe v. Wade to protect a woman’s right to choose — enshrining reproductive rights for decades to come.

Republicans have spent that time since then doing everything in their power to overturn Roe — and they were successful. The Supreme Court ruled in their favor in 2022 to overturn 50 years of legal precedent.

The right to safe, legal abortion access is no longer guaranteed at the federal level in this country, leaving states free to decide the fate of abortion access. Leaving the right to abortion to states means right-wing controlled state and local governments can strip this right from women across the country. The government should not have this kind of control over women’s bodies.

Not only did the Supreme Court’s decision endanger the lives of millions of women, but we’ve also seen women facing criminal charges for traumatic miscarriages or stillbirths since 2022.

When I ran for Governor, I promised to make Maryland a safe haven for abortion access — and I am keeping good on that promise.

In 2023, I signed historic legislation to protect reproductive rights in Maryland. And next, I am working on enshrining abortion rights into our state constitution to protect abortion access for future generations. We will not back down on supporting what’s right.

Our responsibility to fiercely protect and defend the right to an abortion could not be more urgent. The Moore-Miller administration will always stand firmly in support of reproductive freedoms. Abortion care is health care.

Elevate,

Wes

name: Ellen Laitinen
subject: Re: Peter Hernandez Campaign update
body:
Hi All,

I need to correct the location for the Benito Link Candidate Forum. It is at the Granada Theater in Hollister, not Morgan Hill.

The address is: 336 Fifth Street,. Hollister, CA 95023

Sorry for any confusion.
EL

On Wed, Jan 24, 2024 at 7:13 PM Ellen Laitinen <[ellenlaitinen@gmail.com](mailto:ellenlaitinen@gmail.com)> wrote:

> Hello Everyone,
>
>
> For those of you receiving this email for the first time, it's because back in 2022 you had indicated that you wanted to be involved with Peter Hernandez's campaign for congress. Peter is running again for congress and I am reaching out to see if you would be interested in being a volunteer for his 2024 run for congress.
>
>
> Last week Peter began canvassing in Salinas and was well received by the homes he visited. We need to develop a strong canvassing team to help with reaching out to District 18. Peter feels strongly that it is important to make personal contact as much as possible and could use your assistance.
>
>
> If you are interested in volunteering for this, please let me know.
>
>
> On Sunday, January 28th from 2:30-5pm, we will be canvassing in Salinas again. We will be meeting in the parking lot of the **_Assemblies of God church at 1025 Fairview Ave, Salinas, CA 93905_** as our starting point.
>
>
> At 2:30pm, Peter will give a little orientation and then pass out maps of the neighborhoods to canvas.
>
>
>
> Peter also wanted me to extend an invitation to you for an upcoming event at the Granada Theater in downtown Morgan Hill on February 8th. The event is called the _Benito Link Candidate Forum_ and**** is scheduled to be held from 6-8:30pm. The address is:
>
>
> ** _Granada Theater_**
> ** _17440 Monterey Road_**
> ** _Morgan Hill, CA 95037_**
>
>
>
> Please respond to this email if you:
> * Can attend the Benito Link Candidate Forum on February 8th
> * Would be willing to do some canvassing
> * Would like to volunteer (Phone calling, put up signs, etc.)
> * Would like to be taken off this email
>

> Please do not "Reply all" in contacting me, just use the reply button.
>
>
> Thank you for your consideration and hope you are able to come out and support Peter in his campaigning efforts!
>
>
> Ellen Laitinen
> Volunteer Coordinator
> Peter Hernandez for Congress

The goal of corporations is to make a profit. The mission of healthcare is to make and keep people healthy. Privatizing Medicare makes no sense.

Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6046cfa2680a4dfaa02da149fdfd79e5&_e=Ila4q4OCjAPdxbmEFIWvXuTR0nl4VWy0oum-POXVKPHVAQ81CEeJp5PKE3wtzLFJzQr2Txp7GKsCfLx9idMAuutfL_Z6hhs81_eosPAMuvc117VNMp41jhx0yYCv1sq-i4y47bp_z2TmrrOM9hFn61rTDYs4HXKUTElTq-C1PzZhkSKPAP0OBbAMPoXYRu3gROWM6f3uF-4FymTDhue-ZIArdJhF-u0ZemxULX_Kf8sLBWGGfJZ8ZiD2x1s-8Ms2Cf5aDj3p0m6c_37SghhYsTSGy4PCwqqtPwvM1m7bA29ra_EPAdTVS7M5A8wKLATkEFzWGOiD3vIYAv844PHuvS72e4FMaWQNBl2GLPGpKz6TjGZxVqrT89VxFwjGBnrh72INFmIfGktRjflp6O8quH2L3KS36WZR9kYKaNrxcmk%3D)**.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6046cfa2680a4dfaa02da149fdfd79e5&_e=Ila4q4OCjAPdxbmEFIWvXuTR0nl4VWy0oum-POXVKPHVAQ81CEeJp5PKE3wtzLFJzQr2Txp7GKsCfLx9idMAuutfL_Z6hhs81_eosPAMuvc117VNMp41jhx0yYCv1sq-i4y47bp_z2TmrrOM9hFn61rTDYs4HXKUTElTq-C1PzZhkSKPAP0OBbAMPoXYRu3gROWM6f3uF-4FymTDhue-ZIArdJhF-u0ZemxULX_Kf8sLBWGGfJZ8ZiD2x1s-8Ms2Cf5aDj3p0m6c_37SghhYsbE5wXTyZpf2Fm-wnhrRRCWFuvDYCuTCSXwaMxdkTgZbEg6T3X0JM9RPuXsIyCZxxdcSf0cQKeRYbqtbrK4GH6rrFtWkUyF_r4MwY43RNT9aaMqU_rkRcF2ae0jHaXvFYnry8VpwGNSSZraemtEMYI0%3D)
In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

Hi there,

Earlier this week marked 14 years since the _Citizens United_ case was decided in the Supreme Court. This case allowed corporations and special interests to pour unlimited sums of money into our elections.

Now, we’re facing the consequences: **My GOP opponent David Schweikert is a prime example of someone who answers to their corporate bosses rather than the community they were elected to serve.**

As a fresh voice in the Idaho State Senate and a committed member of the Idaho Freedom Caucus, I'm stepping up to say enough is enough.
Our state's financial handling needs a radical overhaul, and it's high time we faced some hard truths.
Our path so far has been treacherous, fueled by an addiction to federal funds and a dangerous habit of rubber-stamping budgets without the necessary scrutiny. This reckless approach is more than just fiscal irresponsibility... _**it's a betrayal of Idaho's core values.**_
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9f69036a-840c-4476-832c-1a020807d35d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The harsh reality is this: every dollar we take from the federal government comes with chains, not just strings. These funds are dragging us deeper into a quagmire of federal debt, stripping away our freedom to govern according to Idaho's unique needs. I'm not just talking about money but _the very essence of our state's sovereignty_.
This dependency on federal money is a ticking time bomb.
### _**
Consider this: during the so-called "pandemic," Idaho received a staggering $22.9 billion in federal funds. To put that into perspective, it's more than double our typical pre-pandemic budget of around $9 billion.
**_
If that doesn't set off alarm bells, I don't know what will. We're on a collision course with disaster if we don't rein in our spending now.
The old guard in our State Senate has been complicit in this financial fiasco. Because for over a decade, they've been all too happy to approve spending bills without batting an eye.
_**The last time a bill was axed on the Senate floor was before the pandemic, back in 2019!**_
During that year, three bills met their end on the Senate floor:
* **House Bill 289,** which can be viewed in detail at the legislature's website [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/25c5224d-e77b-42a3-a115-7ae77c95c73b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **Senate Bill 1210** , available for review [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b23c8ade-b873-48f6-a55a-10d20285e191?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **Senate Bill 1212** , whose specifics are outlined [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6ec47c34-667e-4594-957c-eb20ab1d7675?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

It's been _five years_ since the Idaho Senate killed a spending bill on the floor. The way I see it, this isn't just mediocre governance; _it's a dereliction of duty._
We were elected to serve Idahoans, not to nod along with the status quo, bow to the Governor, or kowtow to the swarms of lobbyists in the Capitol halls.
My point?
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cf441aa6-b366-42d1-a998-ff12836130b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## The era of automatic approvals & blind allegiance must come to an end...
And it's members of the Idaho Freedom Caucus, who are here to shake up the old ways, inject a dose of stringent scrutiny into our state's spending, and fend off out of control spending.
The 2022 mandate was clear: it's time for change, time to restore fiscal sanity in Idaho. Rubber stamping every seingle spending bill that comes along isn't an option. Instead, we must be bold, resist pressure, and always remember our commitment to the people of Idaho.
I urge Idahoans: demand transparency and integrity from your elected officials. Because this is your money, not "the governments."
Even still, we stand at a pivotal juncture and the decisions we make now will shape Idaho's future for decades. _**We must choose the path of fiscal responsibility, independence, and adherence to Idaho's true values.**_
Enough is enough!
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8a011855-f368-4e92-be16-b714b8ad437c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's time to ditch the 'go along to get along' mentality that's plagued our state's finances. _**We're done with spendthrift tactics that treat taxpayer dollars like play money.**_ And as for rubber-stamping budgets without a second thought?
That ends now...
We're at a turning point in Idaho, and it's time for a major reset (_not_ a Great Reset though)!
No more blindly following the path set by others. No more wasteful spending just because that's the way it's always been done. And no more automatic approvals for spending bills that haven't been examined with a fine-tooth comb.
In the Idaho Freedom Caucus, we're leading the charge for this seismic shift. We're here to shake up the status quo and inject a much-needed dose of fiscal discipline into our state's governance. It's time to stand firm, ask the hard questions, and make decisions that truly serve the people of Idaho.
We've been given a clear mandate for change, and we're seizing this opportunity with both hands. We're here to serve Idahoans, not special interests or outdated traditions. It's time to show real leadership, embrace responsibility, and chart a new course towards financial stability and independence.
_**So, let's roll up our sleeves and get to work.** _
Together, we can redefine what it means to govern responsibly in Idaho. Let's put an end to the era of "business as usual" and start a new chapter of prudent, transparent, and accountable governance.
The future of The Gem State depends on it.
Cheers,
Brian
**P.S.**
[Join me on Twitter/X here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b95cd3c8-b4ad-4417-8e4e-000394e9c3e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If you still do Facebook, [click here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8788d8c4-e016-4e93-a2c0-32802fc3c835?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

**P.P.S.**

We have to be realistic about the challenges ahead. The "good ole boys club" entrenched in our political system won't relinquish their grip easily.
This club, a symbol of the old way of doing things, thrives on opacity and backroom deals. They've been the gatekeepers of Idaho's fiscal policies for years, and they won't take kindly to our push for transparency and accountability.
> _**So despite our best efforts, there's STILL a significant chance these forces will work to undermine and possibly derail our efforts to implement a new, transparent fiscal process.**_
They have the experience, the connections, and, frankly, the motivation to maintain the status quo.
This isn't just a possibility; it's a likelihood.
_But acknowledging this doesn't mean we're admitting defeat._ Instead, it highlights the importance of our mission and the need for moral courage, grit, and tenacity. We're up against a deeply entrenched system that has resisted change for years. The road ahead will be tough, and the opposition will be fierce.
In the end, our success will depend on our ability to stay united, focused, and resilient in the face of these challenges. It's a David versus Goliath battle, but history has shown that with the right strategy and enough public support, even the most entrenched systems can be reformed.
_There 'a fight to be had here, no doubt. _
It won't be easy, but the stakes - the financial future and sovereignty of Idaho - are too high to back down. Let's stay the course, keep pushing for transparency, and remember: we're doing this for the people of Idaho, not for the approval of the old guard.

The future of The Gem State depends on it. Cheers, Brian P.S. . If you still do Facebook, . P.P.S. We have to be realistic about the challenges ahead. The "good ole boys club" entrenched in our political system won't relinquish their grip easily. This club, a symbol of the old way of doing things, thrives on opacity and backroom deals. They've been the gatekeepers of Idaho's fiscal policies for years, and they won't take kindly to our push for transparency and accountability. So despite our best efforts, there's STILL a significant chance these forces will work to undermine and possibly derail our efforts to implement a new, transparent fiscal process.** They have the experience, the connections, and, frankly, the motivation to maintain the status quo. This isn't just a possibility; it's a likelihood. But acknowledging this doesn't mean we're admitting defeat. Instead, it highlights the importance of our mission and the need for moral courage, grit, and tenacity. We're up against a deeply entrenched system that has resisted change for years. The road ahead will be tough, and the opposition will be fierce. In the end, our success will depend on our ability to stay united, focused, and resilient in the face of these challenges. It's a David versus Goliath battle, but history has shown that with the right strategy and enough public support, even the most entrenched systems can be reformed. There 'a fight to be had here, no doubt. It won't be easy, but the stakes - the financial future and sovereignty of Idaho - are too high to back down. Let's stay the course, keep pushing for transparency, and remember: we're doing this for the people of Idaho, not for the approval of the old guard. Thanks for reading Brian Lenney (Nampa's Senator)! Something that keeps the well-off and well-connected in control while minimizing the votes and voices of the people. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77675335/451151868/-1197072038?refcode=2024-01-24-theline&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=e5d1e1bb-02bb-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNWQxZTFiYi0wMmJiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=unswqEjF0j7jebGDwax3JwPMGmMOwOdt4ggx0dQCzWo=) The system is called "the line." In 19 of New Jersey's 21 counties, Democratic and Republican county leaders are allowed to place their hand-picked candidates in positions to give them an advantage. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77675336/451151869/-1197072038?refcode=2024-01-24-theline&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=e5d1e1bb-02bb-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNWQxZTFiYi0wMmJiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=unswqEjF0j7jebGDwax3JwPMGmMOwOdt4ggx0dQCzWo=) (Photo of "the line" ballot design. Trust me, I know we have what it takes to overcome this unfair ballot manipulation and strike a major victory for our democracy. Latest polling shows me with a **23 point lead** , and with strong name recognition across the state, **we can win.** It will be competitive, but it's the right thing to do. That's why it's so vital that we raise the resources and funds needed to get our message out to the people. But I have to say that it is so sad to see leaders in the Democratic Party using these unfair tactics to manipulate voters. We are supposed to be the party that defends democracy and stands up against those seeking to circumvent the will of the people. We cannot be hypocritical when it suits us. I decided to run for office more than five years ago because I believe that power belongs to the voters. I've fought against corruption - from big corporate money to Donald Trump's attempts to steal an election - and when I saw that Senator Menendez betrayed the public's trust, I knew I had to take that fight to the Senate. But if corruption exists anywhere, it can thrive everywhere. **That's why we need your support to put an end to corruption in New Jersey - whether it's buying influence through gold bars or buying a place on the ballot through influence.** I am in this race to restore integrity back into our politics, show people that there are public servants that are trying to do the right work, and put the people ahead of personal gain or ambition and just be able to deliver for my state – **and all I'm asking for as a candidate for the United States Senate is that we give the people a fair shot at representation that works for them.** We're working hard to win this election, even with the political reality of "the line." But the truth is it's going to take a lot of resources to keep our strong momentum going to primary day. We need to show voters that a vote for our campaign is a vote to restore trust in government to strengthen our democracy, rooting out corruption through major ethics reform, getting dark money out of politics through campaign finance reform, and empowering voters to elect the candidate of their choice through ballot reform. clean_body: Never forget where you came from | | | That question has been asked and answered in the mainstream media constantly since I was elected Speaker of the House three months ago. It probably won't surprise you that so much of what has been written and said isn't accurate at all. A lot of it has been openly hostile. I wanted to take a moment to clarify a few things here because I expect you agree with me that these things are worth fighting for. From my earliest memories of childhood, my dad was my hero. Because he served as a firefighter and assistant chief training officer, my highest aspiration was to one day become the chief of the fire department of our hometown of Shreveport, Louisiana. But when I was just 12 years old, my dad was critically burned and permanently disabled in the line of duty. That fateful explosion changed the trajectory of all our lives. Following our family tragedy, I had to grow up fast, help my parents take care of my three younger siblings and small family farm, and consider other ways to serve. I became the first person in my family to go to college, and then to law school, and I dedicated my career in constitutional law to defending our fundamental freedoms in the courts. My wife Kelly and I got married in 1999, just as I was beginning my law practice. Like so many other couples, as our family grew, we became increasingly concerned about the condition of our country and what our children's generation would inherit. About nine years ago, after much prayer and deliberation, we decided to heed the call to run for public office and do our best to make a difference. I was elected without opposition to the Louisiana Legislature, and a short time later, to an open seat in the U.S. Congress. Less than seven years after I arrived in Washington, on October 25, 2023, I was unanimously elected by my Republican colleagues to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House. When I was growing up, I never dreamed any of this would be possible. But I am humbled and truly grateful for this opportunity. Friend, you and I both know that America is facing today one of the greatest collections of crises in our nation's history. The survival of our freedoms and the very future of our republic are hanging in the balance. SAVE America, we must keep and GROW the Republican Majority in the House. And to do that, I need partners and fellow warriors who are willing to fight by my side. And it has never been more important for us to stand together, defend truth and liberty, and restore the foundations of this extraordinary country God has given us. It will take all of us to succeed. And I need YOUR help. Sincerely, Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson you consider joining Team Johnson today?____________ | | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana

body:
As you can see, our team is running on all cylinders here at the Center. Stay tuned for more updates soon, but if you want to get more involved... | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10409115?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

With 2024 well underway, I wanted to give you all an update on some of the Center for Renewing America’s (CRA) most important initiatives to start the year.

But first, to all of our new supporters (1,500+ this month so far!) a special welcome from our President, Russ Vought, and all of us here on the CRA team. You’re eager to join the fight, and _we’re thrilled to have you in our ranks_!

Let’s dive in.

→ This month CRA made major strides in **our ethics complaint** against liberal Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson.

→ We exposed the true goals behind the **left’s latest woke crusade** , aka “decolonization” sweeping universities and the hall of Congress.

→ The Wall Street Journal profiled Russ’ efforts to lay the groundwork for the next conservative administration to effectively **rout out the deep state** and make career bureaucrats more accountable to the President.
---
|
---
| **CRA Holding Liberals Supreme Court Justices Accountable**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=720c26d733&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| We have good news to report on our ethics complaint against Biden-appointed Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson (KBJ). The Committee on Financial Disclosures in the Judicial Conference is officially reviewing our complaint against Jackson.

If you recall, CRA recently filed an official ethics complaint against Jackson for willfully failing to disclose the source of her husband’s consulting income and her potential failure to disclose private contributions made to an event celebrating her appointment to the Supreme Court.

As we told [Fox News](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b53e3d22bb&e=17913c7d6d), "we are hopeful that the Judicial Conference takes a long, hard look at the ethics concerns surrounding Justice Jackson and ensures there is not a double standard for justices."

The truth is, liberal justices on the Supreme Court are not held to the same ethical standards as conservatives. Just think of the barrage of allegations, complaints, and phony claims made against Justices Clarence Thomas and others.

With your help, we’re fighting to change that.

**READ IT HERE > Fox News: [Conservative group says Supreme Court justice omitted portions of husband's income on disclosure forms for years](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c5d4357eba&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
|
---
| **Exposing the True Goal of “Decolonization” **
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=03b22466e2&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| **The term “decolonization” has become the latest buzzword** spreading like wildfire on college campuses and in the halls of Congress–especially after the horrific atrocities of Hamas in Israel on October 7.

Similar to “critical race theory” these intentionally innocuous-sounding woke terms are rooted in destructive Marxist ideas. That’s why it’s imperative that conservatives identify and expose the origins and meanings behind their toxic ideologies so Americans can learn what they’re really pushing in schools and in implementing in our woke and weaponized government.

Earlier this month, _CRA published a study_ and thoughtful breakdown exposing the true goal of “decolonization,” aka the complete destruction and abolition of the United States.

**READ IT HERE > CRA Primer: [Renounce Calls for Decolonization in All Their Forms](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=17f980434f&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
|
---
| **A Plan to Take On the Deep State**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=52d00f91c2&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| CRA President Russ Vought [was profiled](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5723bb918b&e=17913c7d6d) in the Wall Street Journal for the groundwork he’s been laying for a America First policy agenda for the next conservative Administration.

Specifically, how a conservative president can structurally get policy victories through the vast entrenched federal bureaucracy controlled by career bureaucrats, or as we more commonly refer to it, “the deep state.”

The problem, as Russ points out, is that “power hasn’t accrued to the president but to a vast federal bureaucracy that, while part of the executive branch, often functions independently.”

The solution is making the federal government look like what the Constitution’s framers intended. A federal bureaucracy more accountable to the President.

**READ IT HERE > Vought in WSJ: [How The Next Conservative Administration Can Fight the Deep State](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d8b93de394&e=17913c7d6d)**

As you can see, our team is running on all cylinders here at the Center. Stay tuned for more updates soon, but if you want to get more involved, one of the best ways is to [support the work we do](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b72bc34380&e=17913c7d6d).

We don’t take money from Big Tech or special interests. It’s people just like you, eager to join the fight.
---
| Sincerely,

Rachel Cauley
Communications Director
Center for Renewing America

Peter,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=362b3bb59eab49ea8f5366beeeb3eede&_e=wYroftiOIGWKLzJglDkM7ZIR2WDZW8yl9epqvWYfSbuDzhfOaXZOfXef-kOmso1Q6Z4n4obGR8-3Dpm5omAUUlIZnlnp3wNh9Mf02kfz1X-YsmcWj16D_9d0_zroRd8NM4aRf3HXBm41GXMxB6S7KG9-kA-q5G18WqtYiXwn_LAETMrB8ywjn9eKnMxUsWgiL0PkZvdTJyLou5U-ibLKEPqU6VJ3nCt03D3wx_ui1azW6MC_y1A11iHEje3AUxTGU6fkdW5P-VIKS4JpOX_TFIRXLth8i0-c6xi_lhzyvFG5IKNNlz4Kl4x6tnAmv04D5atvmKlfP5m7-D70SG6addU5-tz8THgCZOLGfILIudApPkkpNWRAwyCzTy7Xe_ISI47nna0beAW3p2_UvnTMgk7n2TCEdrUvQbxEANWLasE%3D)**.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=362b3bb59eab49ea8f5366beeeb3eede&_e=wYroftiOIGWKLzJglDkM7ZIR2WDZW8yl9epqvWYfSbuDzhfOaXZOfXef-kOmso1Q6Z4n4obGR8-3Dpm5omAUUlIZnlnp3wNh9Mf02kfz1X-YsmcWj16D_9d0_zroRd8NM4aRf3HXBm41GXMxB6S7KG9-kA-q5G18WqtYiXwn_LAETMrB8ywjn9eKnMxUsWgiL0PkZvdTJyLou5U-ibLKEPqU6VJ3nCt03D3wx_ui1azW6MC_y1A11iHEje3AUxTGU6fkdW5P-VIKS4JpOX_TFEx7sWfNoCCd6TZoNfqikTTXVK1Qk-b5IbgYhfy8yQT9ZEhUnsVzsHsxvZNBtWxqktHhMoNmHIoihPokkHfASL2RUGLQZtVNu-MzvlTtLEOqA0RZOyVuwQa04OP_-RA0eswlxvRRDNUiin7dnzPtGes%3D)
In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=362b3bb59eab49ea8f5366beeeb3eede&_e=wYroftiOIGWKLzJglDkM7ZIR2WDZW8yl9epqvWYfSbuDzhfOaXZOfXef-kOmso1Q6Z4n4obGR8-3Dpm5omAUUlIZnlnp3wNh9Mf02kfz1X-YsmcWj16D_9d0_zroRd8NM4aRf3HXBm41GXMxB6S7KG9-kA-q5G18WqtYiXwn_LAETMrB8ywjn9eKnMxUsWgiL0PkZvdTJyLou5U-ibLKEPqU6VJ3nCt03D3wx_ui1azW6MC_y1A11iHEje3AUxTGU6fkdW5P-VIKS4JpOX_TFKVWD84fE1p51msV_QaveLTGdFKuQCkj8ehBkv-05BGbSn7uRG2iq5MPdD6jzamCaxEN2RsdPvyQvQSbYTX37j9qVl7V3GDa4t3D13-6w6zB7ENodqGsEbE6Kz6fYMCCAJTN__U7FhYLIy5lmfe6ufs%3D)**

_**Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. **_

Peter, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. **When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you.**

I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. _And believe me, there are some tales._

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism.** I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why [**I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=362b3bb59eab49ea8f5366beeeb3eede&_e=wYroftiOIGWKLzJglDkM7ZIR2WDZW8yl9epqvWYfSbuDzhfOaXZOfXef-kOmso1Q6Z4n4obGR8-3Dpm5omAUUlIZnlnp3wNh9Mf02kfz1X-YsmcWj16D_9d0_zroRd8NM4aRf3HXBm41GXMxB6S7KG9-kA-q5G18WqtYiXwn_LAETMrB8ywjn9eKnMxUsWgiL0PkZvdTJyLou5U-ibLKEPqU6VJ3nCt03D3wx_ui1azW6MC_y1A11iHEje3AUxTGU6fkdW5P-VIKS4JpOX_TFOqX2WWFF79WNxpvPyCP0PLNWlSEPnr1SaB9kpuUq2e2JwxUpkOHUfVHzaBeswMrHpYBltV7SbDgMfkBZ5SxThgzsHRfnD-2t_KK6oKBJsBDXfyvVKjn6UfG04rauZ3e2MsZjIQUyDdIFdG8TasCE1E%3D)

Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. . In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Peter, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. clean_body: | = Hi there, it’s Adam Schiff. Jason Crow wanted me to reach out. Earlier this week, I was proud to stand on the debate stage in Los Angeles and share our campaign’s unifying message directly with the people of California. But there’s something I can’t get off my mind. = | = In the middle of the debate, my Republican opponent Steve Garvey refused to say whether he’d support Donald Trump — saying “When the time comes...I’ll make my choice.” That’s an unacceptable answer. So I asked him plainly: What more do you need to denounce Donald Trump? = For Steve Garvey, it wasn’t enough that Donald Trump undermined our alliance with NATO. Or that he threw our country’s national security under the bus to buddy up with Vladimir Putin. Or that he dismantled Roe v. Wade and stripped millions of women of their reproductive freedom. Or that he incited the January 6 insurrection and attempted to overthrow the government. That’s where Steve Garvey and I differ. I was censured by MAGA Republicans for standing up to the corrupt president. And I would do it again. I’m not afraid to say that Donald Trump is a danger to our country. So is Mitch McConnell. And Jim Jordan. And the rest of his MAGA enablers who’ve worked tirelessly to hide the truth. The people of California deserve to know whether Steve Garvey believes that a President who incited a violent attack on the Capitol should be trusted with power again. Dear Peter,

As President Trump continues to win the early primaries in historic landslide votes, Illinois Review has posed the question: Will the IL GOP endorse Donald J. Trump for President? It seems now we have our answer.

IL GOP Will Remain Neutral in Presidential Primary While Disgraced Durkin Bashes Trump Despite Historic Primary Victories (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/01/il-gop-will-remain-neutral-in-presidential-primary-while-disgraced-durkin-bashes-trump-despite-historic-primary-victories.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=21cbcf2dc8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Illinois Review

While President Donald Trump cruises to historic, landslide victories in Iowa and New Hampshire, the embattled Illinois Republican Party will remain neutral during the presidential primary season as disgraced former Illinois House Republican leader Jim Durkin – a close ally and confidante to state party chairman Don Tracy, continues to attack the presumptive Republican nominee for President of the United States and his base of loyal supporters.
CLICK TO READ THE FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/01/il-gop-will-remain-neutral-in-presidential-primary-while-disgraced-durkin-bashes-trump-despite-historic-primary-victories.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=21cbcf2dc8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/01/il-gop-will-remain-neutral-in-presidential-primary-while-disgraced-durkin-bashes-trump-despite-historic-primary-victories.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=21cbcf2dc8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

On Wednesday morning, disgraced former Illinois House Republican leader Jim Durkin (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/12/jim-durkins-demise-former-house-gop-leader-admits-defeat-before-battle-blaming-trumps-influence.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=21cbcf2dc8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) told Illinois Playbook (https://www.politico.com/newsletters/illinoisplaybook?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=21cbcf2dc8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that Trump was a “bully, a narcissist and a pathological liar.” Durkin went on to say that “the MAGA’s have co-opted the Republican Party,” and that Republicans will lose big in the November election because of Trump.

A lot of people ask why we send so many emails and texts.
#

Peter, a lot of people ask why we send so many emails and texts.
And the short answer is because they are the biggest source of funding we have. If Ruben wins this race, it will be because we raised enough to do it.
But the long answer is because winning a seat in the U.S. Senate is very, _**very_** expensive. It shouldn’t be — but it is.
Back in 2022, more than $225 million was spent in Arizona’s Senate campaign. Outside groups alone — the special interests, dark money groups, Super PACs — they spent $40 million trying to take Mark Kelly down.
To stand up to money like that, millions of dollars in attack ads, we depend on folks like you. Your donations, whatever you can afford to give.
We don’t have Super PACs lining up around the block to back us up. We don’t have an army of billionaires like Kyrsten Sinema does, or a former president rallying his supporters for us.
We’ve got you. That is why we email so much. It is why your donation today is so important. And it’s why we have to ask:

We're excited to share a special late night episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti that's filled with rapid reactions, political sparks, and lively discussions you won't want to miss!
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=43a4ecc012&e=567664f14c)
In this episode, we dive straight into the aftermath of Donald Trump's win in the New Hampshire primary. Sparks fly as special guest Mike Garofalo joins Mark and Krysty for a spirited discussion. Mark boldly predicts Nikki Haley's political demise after a loss of more than 10 points, but Krysty and Mike have a different take, arguing that Haley will remain in the race until at least South Carolina, her home state. The tension rises as Mark challenges the likelihood of Haley willingly putting her head in a political woodchipper in her home state against Trump.
| [STREAM NEW EPISODE NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=55ffc34dbf&e=567664f14c)
---

The conversation heats up further as we speculate on Trump's potential choice for Vice President. It's a topic that sparks diverse opinions and intriguing predictions.
To wrap things up, we engage in speculation about the Democrats and who might replace Joe Biden on the ticket due to his declining mental health.

body:
#
Derek,
When John won his election to the Senate, he said that our campaign was about “fighting for every person who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up + every community who’s had to build themselves back up.”
That’s what he’s fighting for down in Washington, and it’s what every state deserves in a Senator.
**Unfortunately, New Jersey has a Senator who seems to be in office just to serve himself.** Senator Bob Menendez is accused of accepting bribes (including bars of gold), corrupt dealings with the Egyptian government, and even intervening to prevent a police investigation of his now-wife. _And he’s still running for reelection._
The people of New Jersey deserve a Senator that they can trust. **So last week, John endorsed Rep. Andy Kim in the primary for U.S. Senate.**
**[Will you stand up for integrity + join John by splitting a contribution between our campaign and Andy Kim’s today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240124-1?refcode=em20240124-1-8762&refcode2=8762_434096_wB3Kbk&akid=8762%2E434096%2EwB3Kbk)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240124-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240124-8762&refcode2=8762_434096_wB3Kbk&akid=8762%2E434096%2EwB3Kbk)**
Andy Kim is running to be a Senator that NJ can trust. He’s been a reliable vote for Democratic priorities that will actually help working people in the House, and that’s the sort of guy John needs working with him in the Senate.
Andy has a people-powered team that’s ready for a new generation of leadership, and he’s got the public service experience the Senate needs. Now, he just needs our help.
**[If you’re with John, help Andy Kim in his competitive primary by splitting a contribution of $5 or whatever you can today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240124-1?refcode=em20240124-1-8762&refcode2=8762_434096_wB3Kbk&akid=8762%2E434096%2EwB3Kbk)**
Thank you for everything, Derek. 🙏
-- Team Fetterman

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Magnesium deficiency could be one of the greatest health conspiracies in history...

It powers over 300 critical, life-saving reactions in your body. ([including dozens of shockers mentioned here](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jrFugzAYhJ_GbEH22dgweGga0Sljshv8G6yYBBlQy9tXQVXXu0_3nZvmFMNumTkzYIx-YQCTHwzYVnl3t9s176fr-ef0Vd0xvEt8MmDdZ_on_0ZKmlxM79RcCm8VnAh9QVYYroU0uqqK0dZ1ED5Q6L00qtYCTefgRW04r4UCimjBobiAguQGKFUjpdSdD44aSMOZ4oeoDJloHePzQdm7mPayf01FsuO6zstxrGVoJzc8aYnb1GVyj3XMr20Y3yRD-9z6RC4z2Q6JyYuuHPnQdDJUXvOmV1R3qtKmyNbP3zGluGjDFB8Oe_-afgMAAP__s9Ne_w "including dozens of shockers mentioned here"))

While modern agriculture has stripped our soil and diet of magnesium (and up to 80% of the population is deficient)...

Most fortified foods/products use SYNTHETIC (chemical-made), low-grade magnesium the body can't absorb... AND...

Most ONLY CONTAIN 1-3 forms of magnesium (at best); when the reality is your body needs ALL 7 FORMS OF MAGNESIUM

Given how much magnesium helps with stress, sleep, heart health, energy and more...

It's easily one of the most dangerous health hoaxes ever.

THE GOOD NEWS: **there's a miracle that occurs when your body gets ALL the magnesium that it needs,** in all the forms that it needs, at the optimal dosage.

Just remember -- if you're *only* taking one form of magnesium -- **YOU ARE STILL DEFICIENT**!

Friend,

No more blank checks for the United Nations. Americans' hard-earned dollars have been funneled into initiatives that fly in the face of our values - **enabling tyrants, betraying allies, and spreading bigotry.**

| [**JOIN ME: DEFUND AND DEPART THE UN**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1a0132b8a654491f8c335da013adfe0a&_e=jaQmGhYnDuWJcaqQy1ahpMW2PzmZMr1ZAaoPB7vxDdQbxeOCV2IH2fGkKCKQ1cA6JvPuLx8su9nQr3Q-Rzq-JP9_OG9KPrDZrVMzvjTqf3Sk_jQhQ7At1bW6xWlvEzrvxbdgx-eU09fBrT1Cst1TX1rrTdr9XqeKgRYmLQBhvwYkXWV97s_L6XgGEUc_Nn-YmO8HGa8aEn4RhkVxZt1_eSfxld7gQFyz019zagXWZ4Z1cP7rHmeoWD7KBpteFooo4Bl4HxAOIBqgliDHFbdJVuBfI06iNTgLo0LQnGxQJ1JRRCv2DbmOku1SmJ4NBYU9Aee82XA_s3W_h5Q29fRrjWmBStDYAw_CErwgZDiipW4%3D)

I've had enough, and it's why I've called for the United States to officially stop sending American funds over IMMEDIATELY. **_[Are you with me?](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1a0132b8a654491f8c335da013adfe0a&_e=jaQmGhYnDuWJcaqQy1ahpMW2PzmZMr1ZAaoPB7vxDdQbxeOCV2IH2fGkKCKQ1cA6JvPuLx8su9nQr3Q-Rzq-JP9_OG9KPrDZrVMzvjTqf3Sk_jQhQ7At1bW6xWlvEzrvxbdgx-eU09fBrT1Cst1TX1rrTdr9XqeKgRYmLQBhvwYkXWV97s_L6XgGEUc_Nn-YmO8HGa8aEn4RhkVxZt1_eS4Q7lJODJrWfZPONUMc7E1-AL0K0RpxtuCc7aI5FVJj007blEbRKxHj_JNHo2k-hut5zGQEavjej7skBKyLrrC1oirBGIEgKrlNSE_Wypg2Tw1w5JMXEtEhzoPswEy1TvMTZsnBNftdyC__r3AwQWg%3D)_**

Our fight to preserve the values we hold dear has never been more crucial, and I'm reaching out to you, a dedicated supporter and patriot, to stand with me in this fight. **[Your support has always been a driving force in our mission to defend liberty and limited government.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1a0132b8a654491f8c335da013adfe0a&_e=jaQmGhYnDuWJcaqQy1ahpMW2PzmZMr1ZAaoPB7vxDdQbxeOCV2IH2fGkKCKQ1cA6JvPuLx8su9nQr3Q-Rzq-JP9_OG9KPrDZrVMzvjTqf3Sk_jQhQ7At1bW6xWlvEzrvxbdgx-eU09fBrT1Cst1TX1rrTdr9XqeKgRYmLQBhvwYkXWV97s_L6XgGEUc_Nn-YmO8HGa8aEn4RhkVxZt1_eahJTsaF_iTOud9evdWw7tRfYCiTWrn5ByzUV2L__jUQG3DfdzGUEFb2SSczXVIg1s4gu_QQIvkf1v0ZY3l8uXxzGCLpMIweF0aBkSnzpa9NiMJknkZ6d9L_hosXjFhBOH7_D7Gp9sEjWp_gG8z-qP8%3D)**

subject: Peter vs. methane gas -- this is urgent, we need to hear from you
body:
__Step up while this TRIPLE MATCH is still active. | | | **MEMBERSHIP DRIVE 2024

---|---

| Peter -- our 2023 Membership Drive deadline is just one week away, and this is an important one. Here's the situation: the Department of Energy (DOE) is currently considering its largest-ever application to **export liquefied methane gas** -- a project called Calcasieu Pass 2 (CP2) in southwest Louisiana.

This project is a ticking climate bomb -- with yearly emissions equal to 53 coal-fired power plants or 43 _million_ cars. Our communities and planet simply cannot afford a massive new source of fossil fuel pollution that will make the climate crisis even worse.

The environmental movement has a shot -- a real shot -- at blocking the whole thing, but **it comes down to the kind of pressure we can apply to lawmakers right now. We 're turning to our members to help pull this off.**

[The best thing you can do _right now_ to fight this and other dirty fossil fuel projects is to renew your LCV membership today. For a limited time, every contribution will be TRIPLE MATCHED. Even $5 can make a difference >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

**We 're up against Big Oil lobbyists who are spending BIG to pressure lawmakers to keep business as usual for LNG export decisions -- and we have to make sure our voices are louder.**

_That 's why meeting our membership goal really matters, Peter._ Many LNG export projects, including CP2, would exacerbate the climate crisis, worsen the already hazardous air quality in the Gulf region, and deepen environmental injustices in marginalized communities living nearby. We cannot allow export projects like these to move forward, which is why **environmentalists like you and me need to take action for a better future NOW.**

**LCV is working every day to oppose dirty energy and build a healthy clean energy future for all.** To keep our campaign against LNG exports -- along with the rest of our work -- going strong, we need to raise $50,000 before our midnight deadline this Wednesday, January 31. name: Helena Pasquarella
subject: We Are Stronger Together
body:
Greetings from Ojai!
Thank you for your interest in my Campaign for the 24th District in
Congress.
I have been meeting so many wonderful people at the various events I have
attended in the past weeks. I am energized and inspired by the support I
have been receiving as I speak with like minded people who believe that the
time has come for change in Washington. We believe that people should come
before profits and that our taxes should be spent on
job creation, affordable healthcare and housing, and peace at home instead
of death and destruction abroad.

The primaries are on March 5th, so I need your help in spreading the word
that I am on the ballot. I would love to come to any community events that
are happening in your community so that I can meet voters and let them know
who I am and what I want to represent their concerns in Washington not
corporate interests as Salud Carbajal is doing!

I am attaching my flyer that you are welcome to e-mail or make copies and
hand out to your friends. I need 100 peace promoters to spread the word
to 10 of your friends (1,000) , then they will tell ten of their friends
(10,000), and those 10,000 will tell 10 of their friends (100,000) and I
will have enough votes to advance to the Presidential Elections in
November!
Tomorrow, January 25th, I'll be at UCSB from 12-2 pm for the Rally for
Palestine.
We Are Stronger Together!

*Peace,*
*Helena Pasquarella*
*Candidate for the 24th District*
www.vote4peace2024.com <http://www.vote4peace.com/>
@vote4peace2024

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: The 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Everyone’s story is different, but I know this for certain: the choice to have an abortion belongs to pregnant people, not the government.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240124-3428-footer&t=1&akid=3428%2E420207%2E21dXnI)
Peter,
This week marked the 51st anniversary since the Court’s decision in _Roe v. Wade_ guaranteed abortion rights. It was the right decision and one that would still stand if it weren’t for an extremist, right-wing Court.
We are not free if we cannot make these fundamental choices about our bodies. MAGA Republicans' extreme abortion bans aren’t about saving lives, _they’re about control_.
**We must stand up and fight these bans.[If you’re with me, please add your name to our collective petition to expand the Supreme Court so we can restore balance and protect abortion rights. ](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-scotus-petition_20240124/?source=em20240124-3428&akid=3428%2E420207%2E21dXnI)**
**[Add your name ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-scotus-petition_20240124/?source=em20240124-3428&akid=3428%2E420207%2E21dXnI)**
Everyone’s story is different, but I know this for certain: **the choice to have an abortion belongs to pregnant people, not the government.**
Come November, we have the choice to vote for Democrats who are leading the fight to restore abortion rights, unlike Republicans who are hellbent on banning them. But we _must seize every opportunity_ between now and then to protect our rights.
The current right-wing Supreme Court is unethical, unaccountable, and out of control, and it must be reformed. Reforming the Court starts with adding four new justices who will restore balance and integrity. Congress has changed the number of justices on the Court a half-dozen times throughout American history, and it can do so again at any time. That time is now.
**[Add your name today to amplify our call to expand SCOTUS and protect abortion rights.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-scotus-petition_20240124/?source=em20240124-3428&akid=3428%2E420207%2E21dXnI)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Robert Slater 4 Congress
subject: Please join our movement
body:
Our campaign is a campaign you can support

| | |
### Robert Slater 4 Congress
---
---
Hello Friend I hope this email finds you in good health and high spirits. My name is Robert Slater, and I am honored to introduce myself as the congressional candidate running to represent the vibrant community of Texas's 18th District. First and foremost, I want to extend a warm welcome to you as a valued member of our community. Your engagement and support are the bedrock of our democratic process, and I am excited to embark on this journey with individuals like yourself who share a commitment to positive change. As we kick off this campaign, I am reaching out to you with a sense of optimism and purpose. Together, we have the opportunity to shape the future of TX-18 and address the pressing issues that matter most to our community. Fundraising Appeal: I am reaching out to you today to request your support in the form of a financial contribution to our campaign. Your generous donations will play a pivotal role in ensuring we have the resources needed to effectively communicate our message, engage with voters, and make a lasting impact. Whether it's advocating for healthcare reform, championing education, or addressing critical infrastructure needs, your support will directly contribute to building a stronger and more vibrant TX-18. To make a donation, please visit [DONATE](https://robslater.nationbuilder.com/donate?e=2191ac5a407556e1f10f7fc89f4dd781&utm_source=robslater&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=5&n=1). Every dollar counts, and your contribution, no matter the amount, will make a significant difference. Welcome to the Campaign: I am thrilled to have you on board, and I want you to know that your involvement is crucial to our success. We have a dedicated team of volunteers working tirelessly, and I invite you to join us in making a positive impact. Here's how you can get involved:
1. **Donate:** Your financial support is vital – visit [Donate](https://robslater.nationbuilder.com/donate?e=2191ac5a407556e1f10f7fc89f4dd781&utm_source=robslater&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=5&n=2) to contribute.
2. **Volunteer:** Consider joining our team of passionate volunteers. Your time and energy can make a real difference.
3. **Spread the Word:** Share our campaign with your friends, family, and neighbors. Your endorsement is invaluable.

Together, we can create a brighter future for TX-18. I am truly grateful for your consideration and support. If you have any questions or if there's anything you'd like to discuss, please feel free to reply to this email. Thank you for being a part of this journey, and I look forward to working together to bring positive change to TX-18. Warm regards, Robert Slater
---
